source.sqlReaderQuery:
WITH cases as
(
SELECT DISTINCT
      cases.CaseNodeId, 
	  dtree.SubType,  
	  cases.CaseReference, 
	  cases.CaseUniqueId as case_number
      
FROM
      Horizon_CaseReference cases
      INNER JOIN DTree dtree ON cases.CaseNodeId = dtree.DataID
      INNER JOIN Horizon_TypeOfCase t ON cases.CaseTypeId = t.ID
WHERE
	  dtree.OwnerID != -235834 	-- Recycle bin ownerid
	  AND t.CaseworkType IN ('Appeal', 'CommonLand', 'Costs', 'Environment', 'RightsOfWay')
)
,
case_involvement(DataId, ContactID, ContactDetails, TypeOfInvolvement) AS
       (SELECT DISTINCT d.DataId AS DataId, ll1.ValStr AS [ContactID], ll2.ValStr AS [ContactDetails], ll3.ValStr AS [TypeOfInvolvement]
       FROM DTree d
		   INNER JOIN llattrdata ll1 ON d.DataId = ll1.Id
		   INNER JOIN llattrdata ll2 ON d.DataId = ll2.Id
		   INNER JOIN llattrdata ll3 ON d.DataId = ll3.Id
       WHERE
		   ll1.DefId = 95501 AND ll1.AttrId = 20
		   AND ll2.DefId = 95501 AND ll2.AttrId = 19
		   AND ll3.DefId = 95501 AND ll3.AttrId = 3 
		   --exclude PINS staff case involvement roles
		   --AND ll3.ValStr NOT IN ('Case Manager', 'Case Officer', 'Inspector', 'Assistant Case Officer', 'Environmental Services Officer', 'Programme Officer', 'Legal Officer', 'Previous Inspector')
		   AND ll1.ParentKeyId = ll2.ParentKeyId
		   AND ll1.ParentKeyId = ll3.ParentKeyId)

SELECT DISTINCT
	cr.case_number,
	D.CreateDate as case_created_date,
	ci.ContactID,
	ci.TypeOfInvolvement,
	v.ContactType,
	v.FirstName,
	v.LastName,
	v.PostName,
	v.Title,
	v.Salutation,
	v.Suffix,
	v.POBox,
	v.Address1,
	v.Address2,
	v.City,
	v.County,
	v.Postcode,
	v.Country,
	v.TelephoneOffice,
	v.TelephoneMobile,
	v.Fax,
	v.Email,
	v.LPACode,
	v.OrganisationName,
	t.OrganisationTypeName
FROM 
	cases cr
		INNER JOIN DTree D ON cr.CaseNodeId = D.DataID
		INNER JOIN case_involvement ci on D.DataID = ci.DataId
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Horizon_vw_AllContacts] v on ci.ContactID =v.Id
		LEFT JOIN Contacts_OrganisationType t on v.OrganisationTypeID = t.ID
--WHERE
--			case_number = 3000079

properties.description:
This is the top level of the source to raw pipeline for Fileshare files, currently being used for SAP HR files.

Description of the default parameters: 
-jsonschema: schema definition for the table to log the file transfer
-db_name: the synapse database for the file transfer log table
-table_name: the name of the table inside -db_name for the file transfer log table
-target_container: the abfss:// file path container of the file transfer log table
-target_folder: the folder within which the delta table will be located
-akv_name: the name of the key vault containing the secret to obtain the connection string to the file share
-secret_name: the name of the secret within akv_name containing the connection string to access the file share
-kv_linked_service: the linked service name of the key vault akv_name
-share_name: the name of the Azure Fileshare
-directory_path: the path within the Azure Fileshare to identify all files within
-sink_sourcetype: The top level folder within odw-raw to transfer the data from Fileshare into
-sink_sourcesystem: The subfolder within sink_sourcetype to transfer the data into

This notebook creates the table for the Azure Fileshare transfer logging if the Delta log table does not exist.

This notebook then generates the file paths from Azure Fileshare for the copy activity to copy into raw, for any new or modified files, based on existing information in the log table.

content.query:
/****************************************************************************

DaRT query to retrieve case data and related information.

There are 5 columns where multiple rows per case are possible, i.e.

Specialism
ContactID
GroundForAppeal
Events
ChartStatus

Linked cases will be a 6th field which will cause multiple rows to be returned.
A seperate pydantic model will need to be created in model_dart.py to handle this.

****************************************************************************/

USE ODW_HARMONISED_DB;

WITH SAMPLE_CASES AS 
(
SELECT      
                    
                    t1.CaseReference,
                    t1.AppealRefNumber,
                    t6.ApplicationType,
                    t6.AppealTypeReason,
                    t6.AppealTypeGroup,
                    t6.AppealType,
                    t12.ProcedureName,
                    t1.validity,
                    t5.ProcessingState,
                    t6.LinkedAppeal,
                    t21.LastPublishedDate,
                    t7.LPACode,
                    t7.LPAName,
                    t6.Jurisdiction,
                    t5.DevelopmentOrAllegation,
                    t5.CaseProcess,
                    t6.DevelopmentType,
                    t22.RelatedReferences,
                    t5.AppealSourceIndicator,
                    t5.Level,
                    t8.Specialism,
                    t9.SpecialCircumstance,
                    t5.AppellantStatementSubmitted,
                    t15.WelshLanguage,
                    t5.ProcedureAppellant,
                    t6.AppealRecDate,
                    t6.AppealStartDate,
                    t1.ValidTo,
                    t10.ValidityStatusDate,
                    t5.CallInDate,
                    t5.TargetDate,
                    t5.StatementsDue,
                    t5.ThirdPartyRepsDue,
                    t5.FinalCommentsDue,
                    t5.StatementOfCommonGroundDue,
                    t5.ProofsDue,
                    t22.ConsentDate,
                    t12.OwnershipPermission,
                    t11.ModifyDate,
                    t12.LpaDecisionDate,
                    t13.OutcomePublicSafety,
                    t13.AdvertDetailsID,
                    t13.ReasonPublicSafety,
                    t13.OutcomeAmenity,
                    t13.ReasonAmenity,
                    t13.IsActive as AdvertInPosition,
                    t13.SignDescription as AdvertDescription,
                    t5.LPAApplicationDate,
                    t5.LPAApplicationReference,
                    t23.Section,
                    JSON_QUERY('["' + STRING_AGG(t14.ContactID, '","') + '"]') as ContactIDs,
                    -- t14.Title,
                    -- t14.Salutation,
                    -- t14.FirstName,
                    -- t14.LastName,
                    -- t14.TypeOfInvolvement,
                    t15.AddressLine1,
                    t15.AddressLine2,
                    t15.AddressTown,
                    t15.PostCode,
                    t15.Easting,
                    t15.Northing,
                    t5.InspectorNeedToEnterSite,
                    t5.NumberOfResidences,
                    t5.AreaOfSiteInHectares,
                    t5.FloorSpaceInSquareMetres,
                    t5.SiteGreenBelt,
                    t5.HistoricBuildingGrantMade,
                    t5.AgriculturalHolding,
                    JSON_QUERY('["' + STRING_AGG(t16.GroundForAppeal, '","') + '"]') as GroundsForAppeal,
                    -- t16.GroundLetter,
                    t16.GroundForAppealStartDate,
                    JSON_QUERY('["' + STRING_AGG(t18.EventType, '","') + '"]') as EventTypes,
                    t17.EstPrepTime,

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW miPINS.vw_mipins_high_court
AS
--Table Alias Key: 

--HCD   = [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[high_court_dim]
--CF    = [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[casework_case_fact]
--CAAD  = [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[casework_all_appeals_dim]
--HBE   = [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[casework_event_dim]


SELECT DISTINCT
HCD.AppealRefNumber                                             AS [AppNum],
HCD.HCRef                                                       AS [HC Ref],
HCD.CaseName                                                    AS [Case Name],
HCD.GLList                                                      AS [GL List],
HCD.[Procedure]                                                 AS [Procedure Type],
HCD.ClaimDate                                                   AS [Claim Date],
HCD.AppealType                                                  AS [Appeal Type],
HCD.Challenge                                                   AS [Challenge Type],
HCD.IsPCO                                                       AS [Protective Costs Order Applications Flag],
HCD.DateOfDL                                                    AS [Date Of Appeal Decision Letter],
HCD.FileToDIROrIMDate                                           AS [Date Inspector Comments Requested],
HCD.ICToTSDDate                                                 AS [Date Inspector Comments sent to GLD],
HCD.AdviceDate                                                  AS [Date GLD Advice Received],
HCD.InstToTSDDate                                               AS [Date Instruction Sent to GLD],
HCD.Instruct                                                    AS [PINS Instruction],
HCD.ConsentDate                                                 AS [Date of Final Consent Order],
HCD.DateOfHearing                                               AS [Date of Hearing],
HCD.Outcome                                                     AS [Court Outcome],
HCD.CourtDate                                                   AS [Date of Sealed Court Order],
HCD.TranscriptDate                                              AS [Date of Final Judgement],
HCD.IsAppeal                                                    AS [Seeking Court of Appeal Flag],
HCD.Applicant                                                   AS [Applicant],
HCD.SSEDefend                                                   AS [SSE Defend],
HCD.Outcome2                                                    AS [Outcome CoA],
HCD.CourtOrderDate                                              AS [Date of Court Order],
HCD.TranscriptReceivedDate                                      AS [Date Transcript Received],
HCD.PINSAA                                                      AS [PINS AA for Redetermined],
HCD.IsOriginal                                                  AS [SC Flag],
HCD.Outcome2                                                    AS [SC Outcome],
HCD.IsRedet                                                     AS [RD Flag],
HCD.RedetFile                                                   AS [RD File],
HCD.RedetMinute                                                 AS [RD Minute],
HCD.AreCostsToBeWrittenOff                                      AS [Costs to be Written Off Flag],
HCD.CaseCosts                                                   AS [Costs Type],
HCD.CaseStatus                                                  AS [Costs Status],
HCD.CaseAmount                                                  AS [Costs Amount],
HCD.InvoiceDate                                                 AS [Costs Invoice Date],
HCD.DebtRecoveryDate                                            AS [Date Referred for Debt Recovery],
HCD.PaymentReceivedDate                                         AS [Payment Received Date],
CAAD.AppealRecDate                                              AS [Appeal Received Date],
HCD.ValidTo                                                     AS [Appeal Valid Date],
HBE.hzn_event_date                                              AS [Appeal Event Date],
CAAD.AppealDecidedDate                                          AS [Appeal Decision Date],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.IsWelshOffice='True' 
        THEN 'Wales'
            ELSE 'England'
END                                                             AS Country,
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.HCRef LIKE 'HC%' 
        THEN 'HC'
     WHEN HCD.HCRef LIKE 'DPD%' 
        THEN 'DPD'
	 WHEN HCD.HCRef LIKE 'NSIP%' 
        THEN 'NSIP'
	 WHEN HCD.HCRef LIKE 'RoW%' 
        THEN 'RoW'
	 WHEN HCD.HCRef LIKE 'SOS%' 
        THEN 'SOS'
            ELSE 'OTHER'
END                                                             AS [Claim Type],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.AppealRefNumber IS NULL 
        THEN 'N'
     WHEN HCD.AppealRefNumber IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Y'
END                                                             AS [PINS Appeal Flag],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATEDIFF(WK,HCD.DateOfDL,HCD.ClaimDate)                         AS [Date Of Decision to Date Claim - Weeks],
CASE WHEN ISNULL(HCD.ConsentDate,'2099-01-01') <= ISNULL(HCD.CourtDate,'2099-01-01') 
     AND ISNULL(HCD.ConsentDate,'2099-01-01') <= ISNULL(HCD.TranscriptDate,'2099-01-01') 
        THEN HCD.ConsentDate
	  WHEN ISNULL(HCD.CourtDate,'2099-01-01') <= ISNULL(HCD.ConsentDate,'2099-01-01') 
      AND ISNULL(HCD.CourtDate,'2099-01-01') <= ISNULL(HCD.TranscriptDate,'2099-01-01') 
        THEN HCD.CourtDate
            ELSE HCD.TranscriptDate
END                                                             AS [HC Outcome Date],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN ISNULL(HCD.CourtOrderDate,'2099-01-01') <= ISNULL(HCD.TranscriptReceivedDate,'2099-01-01')  
        THEN HCD.CourtOrderDate
            ELSE HCD.TranscriptReceivedDate
END                                                             AS [COA Outcome Date],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.Outcome IS NULL 
     AND HCD.Outcome2 IS NULL 
     AND HCD.SSEOutcome IS NULL 
        THEN 'OPEN'
	 WHEN HCD.Outcome IS NOT NULL OR HCD.Outcome2 IS NOT NULL 
     AND HCD.SSEOutcome IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'CLOSED'
END                                                             AS [Status],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.IsOriginal = 'True' 
     AND HCD.SSEOutcome IS NULL 
        THEN 'Supreme Court'
	 WHEN HCD.IsAppeal = 'True' 
     AND HCD.Outcome2 IS NULL 
        THEN 'Court of Appeal'
	 WHEN HCD.InstToTSDDate IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Instruction to GLD Sent'
	 WHEN HCD.AdviceDate IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'GLD Advice Received'
	 WHEN HCD.ICToTSDDate IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Inspector Comments to GLD'
	 WHEN HCD.FileToDIROrIMDate IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Inspector Comments Requested'
END                                                             AS [Open Stage],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATEDIFF(WK,HCD.FileToDIROrIMDate,HCD.ICToTSDDate)              AS [IC Comment Requested to Received - Weeks],

CASE WHEN HCD.Outcome IS NOT NULL 
     AND HCD.Outcome2 IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Court of Appeal'
	  WHEN HCD.Outcome IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'High Court'
	  WHEN HCD.Outcome2 IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Court of Appeal'
	  WHEN HCD.SSEOutcome IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Supreme Court'
END                                                             AS [Claim End Type],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATEDIFF(dd,HCD.ClaimDate,GETDATE())/7 AS [Age as of Today (In Weeks)],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.Outcome IN ('Perm. Refused', 'Struck Out', 'Withdrawn', 'Won') 
        THEN 'Y'
            ELSE 'N'
END                                                             AS [HC Win],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.SSEOutcome IN ('Perm R', 'Withdrawn', 'Won') 
        THEN 'Y'
            ELSE 'N'
END                                                             AS [COA Win],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.Challenge = 's288' 
        THEN 'Planning'
	 WHEN HCD.Challenge IN ('s289', 's288/s289') 
        THEN 'Enforcement'
	 WHEN HCD.Challenge = 'JR' 
        THEN 'JR'
	 WHEN HCD.Challenge IN ('s113','Other') 
        THEN 'Other'
	 WHEN HCD.Challenge = 'PAP' 
        THEN 'PAP'
	        ELSE HCD.Challenge
END                                                             AS [Challenge Grouping]

FROM [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[high_court_dim]                 AS HCD
LEFT JOIN [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[casework_case_fact]        AS CF
    ON CF.AppealRefNumber = HCD.AppealRefNumber
LEFT JOIN [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[casework_all_appeals_dim]  AS CAAD

--CREATE VIEW FOR HIGH COURT--

 CREATE OR ALTER VIEW miPINS.vw_mipins_high_court
 AS
--Table Alias Key: 

--HCD   = [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[high_court_dim]
--CF    = [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[casework_case_fact]
--CAAD  = [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[casework_all_appeals_dim]
--HBE   = [odw_standardised_db].[dbo].[horizon_bis_event]


SELECT DISTINCT
HCD.AppealRefNumber                                             AS [AppNum],
HCD.HCRef                                                       AS [HC Ref],
HCD.CaseName                                                    AS [Case Name],
HCD.GLList                                                      AS [GL List],
HCD.[Procedure]                                                 AS [Procedure Type],
HCD.ClaimDate                                                   AS [Claim Date],
HCD.AppealType                                                  AS [Appeal Type],
HCD.Challenge                                                   AS [Challenge Type],
HCD.IsPCO                                                       AS [Protective Costs Order Applications Flag],
HCD.CaseArea                                                    AS [Area],
HCD.DateOfDL                                                    AS [Date Of Appeal Decision Letter],
HCD.FileToDIROrIMDate                                           AS [Date Inspector Comments Requested],
HCD.ICToTSDDate                                                 AS [Date Inspector Comments sent to GLD],
HCD.AdviceDate                                                  AS [Date GLD Advice Received],
HCD.InstToTSDDate                                               AS [Date Instruction Sent to GLD],
HCD.Instruct                                                    AS [PINS Instruction],
HCD.ConsentDate                                                 AS [Date of Final Consent Order],
HCD.DateOfHearing                                               AS [Date of Hearing],
HCD.Outcome                                                     AS [Court Outcome],
HCD.CourtDate                                                   AS [Date of Sealed Court Order],
HCD.TranscriptDate                                              AS [Date of Final Judgement],
HCD.TranscriptNumber                                            AS [Reason for Decision],
HCD.IsAppeal                                                    AS [Seeking Court of Appeal Flag],
HCD.Applicant                                                   AS [Applicant],
HCD.SSEDefend                                                   AS [SSE Defend],
HCD.Outcome2                                                    AS [Outcome CoA],
HCD.CourtOrderDate                                              AS [Date of Court Order],
HCD.TranscriptReceivedDate                                      AS [Date Transcript Received],
HCD.PINSAA                                                      AS [PINS AA for Redetermined],
HCD.IsOriginal                                                  AS [SC Flag],
HCD.SSEOutcome                                                  AS [SC Outcome],
HCD.IsRedet                                                     AS [RD Flag],
HCD.RedetFile                                                   AS [RD File],
HCD.RedetMinute                                                 AS [RD Minute],
HCD.AreCostsToBeWrittenOff                                      AS [Costs to be Written Off Flag],
HCD.CaseCosts                                                   AS [Costs Type],
HCD.CaseStatus                                                  AS [Costs Status],
HCD.CaseAmount                                                  AS [Costs Amount],
HCD.InvoiceDate                                                 AS [Costs Invoice Date],
HCD.DebtRecoveryDate                                            AS [Date Referred for Debt Recovery],
HCD.PaymentReceivedDate                                         AS [Payment Received Date],
CAAD.AppealRecDate                                              AS [Appeal Received Date],
HCD.ValidTo                                                     AS [Appeal Valid Date],
HBE.hzn_event_date                                              AS [Appeal Event Date],
CAAD.AppealDecidedDate                                          AS [Appeal Decision Date],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.IsWelshOffice='True' 
        THEN 'Wales'
            ELSE 'England'
END                                                             AS Country,
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.HCRef LIKE 'HC%' 
        THEN 'HC'
     WHEN HCD.HCRef LIKE 'DPD%' 
        THEN 'DPD'
	 WHEN HCD.HCRef LIKE 'NSIP%' 
        THEN 'NSIP'
	 WHEN HCD.HCRef LIKE 'ROW%' 
        THEN 'RoW'
	 WHEN HCD.HCRef LIKE 'SOS%' 
        THEN 'SOS'
            ELSE 'OTHER'
END                                                             AS [Claim Type],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.AppealRefNumber IS NULL 
        THEN 'N'
     WHEN HCD.AppealRefNumber IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Y'
END                                                             AS [PINS Appeal Flag],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATEDIFF(WK,HCD.DateOfDL,HCD.ClaimDate)                         AS [Date Of Decision to Date Claim - Weeks],
CASE WHEN ISNULL(HCD.ConsentDate,'2099-01-01') <= ISNULL(HCD.CourtDate,'2099-01-01') 
     AND ISNULL(HCD.ConsentDate,'2099-01-01') <= ISNULL(HCD.TranscriptDate,'2099-01-01') 
        THEN HCD.ConsentDate
	  WHEN ISNULL(HCD.CourtDate,'2099-01-01') <= ISNULL(HCD.ConsentDate,'2099-01-01') 
      AND ISNULL(HCD.CourtDate,'2099-01-01') <= ISNULL(HCD.TranscriptDate,'2099-01-01') 
        THEN HCD.CourtDate
            ELSE HCD.TranscriptDate
END                                                             AS [HC Outcome Date],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN ISNULL(HCD.CourtOrderDate,'2099-01-01') <= ISNULL(HCD.TranscriptReceivedDate,'2099-01-01')  
        THEN HCD.CourtOrderDate
            ELSE HCD.TranscriptReceivedDate
END                                                             AS [COA Outcome Date],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN (HCD.Outcome IS NULL OR HCD.Outcome = '')
     AND (HCD.Outcome2 IS NULL OR HCD.Outcome2 = '')
     AND (HCD.SSEOutcome IS NULL OR HCD.SSEOutcome = '')
        THEN 'OPEN'
	 WHEN (HCD.Outcome IS NOT NULL OR HCD.Outcome <> '' OR HCD.Outcome2 IS NOT NULL OR HCD.Outcome2 <> '')
     AND (HCD.SSEOutcome IS NOT NULL OR HCD.SSEOutcome <> '')
        THEN 'CLOSED'
END                                                             AS [Status],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.IsOriginal = 'True' 
     AND HCD.SSEOutcome IS NULL 
        THEN 'Supreme Court'
	 WHEN HCD.IsAppeal = 'True' 
     AND HCD.Outcome2 IS NULL 
        THEN 'Court of Appeal'
	 WHEN HCD.InstToTSDDate IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Instruction to GLD Sent'
	 WHEN HCD.AdviceDate IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'GLD Advice Received'
	 WHEN HCD.ICToTSDDate IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Inspector Comments to GLD'
	 WHEN HCD.FileToDIROrIMDate IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Inspector Comments Requested'
END                                                             AS [Open Stage],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATEDIFF(WK,HCD.FileToDIROrIMDate,HCD.ICToTSDDate)              AS [IC Comment Requested to Received - Weeks],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.Outcome IS NOT NULL 
     AND HCD.Outcome2 IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Court of Appeal'
	  WHEN HCD.Outcome IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'High Court'
	  WHEN HCD.Outcome2 IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Court of Appeal'
	  WHEN HCD.SSEOutcome IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Supreme Court'
END                                                             AS [Claim End Type],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATEDIFF(dd,HCD.ClaimDate,GETDATE())/7                          AS [Age as of Today (In Weeks)],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.Outcome IN ('Perm. Refused', 'Struck Out', 'Withdrawn', 'Won') 
        THEN 'Y'
            ELSE 'N'
END                                                             AS [HC Win],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.SSEOutcome IN ('Perm R', 'Withdrawn', 'Won') 
        THEN 'Y'
            ELSE 'N'
END                                                             AS [COA Win],
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE WHEN HCD.Challenge = 's288' 
        THEN 'Planning'
	 WHEN HCD.Challenge IN ('s289', 's288/s289') 
        THEN 'Enforcement'
	 WHEN HCD.Challenge = 'JR' 
        THEN 'JR'
	 WHEN HCD.Challenge IN ('s113','Other') 
        THEN 'Other'
	 WHEN HCD.Challenge = 'PAP' 
        THEN 'PAP'
	        ELSE HCD.Challenge
END                                                             AS [Challenge Grouping]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FROM [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[high_court_dim]                 AS HCD
LEFT JOIN [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[casework_case_fact]        AS CF
    ON CF.AppealRefNumber = HCD.AppealRefNumber
LEFT JOIN [odw_harmonised_db].[dbo].[casework_all_appeals_dim]  AS CAAD
    ON CAAD.AppealRefNumber = CF.AppealRefNumber
LEFT JOIN [odw_standardised_db].[dbo].[horizon_bis_event]       AS HBE
    ON HBE.Appeal_Reference_Number = CF.AppealRefNumber

GO

--CREATE VIEW FOR PROTECTED DATA--

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW miPINS.vw_mipins_hr_protected_data

AS

SELECT DISTINCT
		T10.CalendarDate AS PCDate,
		LEFT(T10.CalendarMonth,3) AS PCMonth,
		T10.MonthOfYear AS MonthInt,
		concat(LEFT(T10.CalendarMonth,3),' - ', RIGHT(T10.CalendarYear, 2)) AS PCMonthLatest, 
		concat('-',T10.CalendarYear,RIGHT(100+T10.MonthOfYear,2)) AS MonthYearLatestSortKey,
		T10.CalendarYear AS PCYear,
		T10.FinancialYear AS PCFY,
		concat('FY-',RIGHT(T10.FinancialYear, 2))  AS PCFYLatest,
		T10.FinancialYear AS FYLatestSortKey,
		T1.SourceID AS RefNumber,
		T2.DisabilityCode AS DisabilityText,
		CASE 
			WHEN T2.Description IS NULL THEN 'No Record'
			WHEN T2.Description IN ('DISABLED','Yes') THEN 'Yes'
			WHEN T2.Description IN ('NOT DISABLED', 'No') THEN 'No'
			WHEN T2.Description IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose', '0') THEN 'Unknown'
		END AS Disabled,
		T3.Description AS EthnicOrigin,
		CASE WHEN T3.Description IS NULL THEN 'No Record'
			WHEN T3.Description LIKE 'White%' THEN 'White'
			WHEN T3.Description IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','0','Not known') THEN 'Unknown'
		   ELSE 'BME'
		END AS Ethnicity,
		CASE
			WHEN T1.ReligionID IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
			ELSE T4.ReligionCode 
		END AS ReligiousDenominationKey,
		CASE
			WHEN T4.ReligionCode IS NULL THEN 'No Record'
			WHEN T4.ReligionCode IN ('None','Agnostic / Atheist') OR LEFT(T4.ReligionCode,3) IN ('ath','agn') THEN 'Agnostic / Atheist'
			WHEN T4.ReligionCode = 'Christian' THEN 'Christian'
			WHEN T4.ReligionCode IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','0') THEN 'Unknown'
		   	ELSE 'Other Religion'
		END AS Religion,
		T5.Description AS SxO,
		CASE 
			WHEN T5.Description IS NULL THEN 'No Record'
			WHEN T5.Description ='Heterosexual' THEN 'Heterosexual'
			WHEN LEFT(T5.Description,3) IN ('Gay','Les','Bis') THEN 'LGBT'
			WHEN T5.Description IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','Other','0') THEN 'Unknown'
		    ELSE 'Other'
		END AS SexualOrientation,
        '1' AS PCHeadcount,
		CASE 
			WHEN T2.Description IS NULL OR T2.Description IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','0','Not known') 
				THEN 'No Record or Data not supplied for one or more categories.'

%%sql
create or replace table calendar_dim_plus
using delta
location '/odw_harmonised_db/calendar_dim_plus'
as select
  year(calendarDate) * 10000 + month(calendarDate) * 100 + day(calendarDate) as dateInt,
  CalendarDate,
  CalendarDate - day(calendarDate) + 1 AS FirstOfMonth,
  year(calendarDate) AS CalendarYear,
  date_format(calendarDate, 'MMMM') as CalendarMonth,
  month(calendarDate) as MonthOfYear,
  date_format(calendarDate, 'EEEE') as DayName,
  dayofweek(calendarDate) AS DayOfWeek,
  weekday(calendarDate) + 1 as DayOfWeekStartMonday,
  year(current_date)-year(calendarDate) AS AGE,
  case
    when weekday(calendarDate) < 5 then 'Y'
    else 'N'
  end as IsWeekDay,
  dayofmonth(calendarDate) as DayOfMonth,
  case
    when calendarDate = last_day(calendarDate) then 'Y'
    else 'N'
  end as IsLastDayOfMonth,
  dayofyear(calendarDate) as DayOfYear,
  weekofyear(calendarDate) as WeekOfYearIso,
  quarter(calendarDate) as QuarterOfYear,
  /* Use financial periods needed by organization financial calendar */
  case
    when month(calendarDate) < 4 then year(calendarDate) -1
    else year(calendarDate)
  end as FinancialYear,
  case
    when month(calendarDate) < 4 then year(calendarDate) 
    else year(calendarDate) +1
  end as NextFinancialYear,
  CASE
    when quarter(calendarDate) =1 then 4
    else quarter(calendarDate) -1
  END as FinancialQuarter,
  concat(FinancialYear,'-',NextFinancialYear) as FinancialPeriod,
  concat(MonthOfYear,'-',CalendarYear) AS MonthANDYear,
    CASE
    WHEN FinancialYear =  year(current_timestamp) and month(current_timestamp)>3 THEN 'CurrentFY'
    WHEN FinancialYear =  year(current_timestamp)-1 and month(current_timestamp)<4 THEN 'CurrentFY'  
    WHEN FinancialYear =  year(current_timestamp)-1 and month(current_timestamp)>3 THEN 'PreviousFY'
    WHEN FinancialYear =  year(current_timestamp) and month(current_timestamp)<4 THEN 'PreviousFY'
    WHEN FinancialYear =  year(current_timestamp)-1 and month(current_timestamp)<4 THEN 'OlderFY'
    WHEN FinancialYear =  year(current_timestamp)-2 and month(current_timestamp)>3 THEN 'OlderFY'   
    WHEN FinancialYear < year(current_timestamp)-2 THEN 'OlderFY'
    ELSE 'FutureFY'
  END AS financial_year,
  CASE
    WHEN CalendarYear = year(current_timestamp) then 'CurrentCY'
    WHEN CalendarYear = year(current_timestamp) - 1 then 'PreviousCY'
    WHEN CalendarYear < year(current_timestamp) - 1 then 'OlderCY'
    ELSE 'FutureCY'
  END AS calendar_year
from
    calendar_dim

%%sql
-- First step is to work out the data in standardised that we need to move to harmonised
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW vw_Horizon_appeals_event
AS
SELECT
    CONCAT(raw.casenumber, '-',raw.eventId) AS eventId
    ,raw.caseReference
    ,raw.eventType
    ,raw.eventName
    ,raw.eventstatus
    ,raw.isUrgent
    ,raw.eventPublished
    ,raw.eventStartDatetime
    ,raw.eventEndDatetime
    ,raw.notificationOfSitevisit
    ,raw.AddressLine1
    ,raw.AddressLine2
    ,raw.AddressTown
    ,raw.AddressCounty
    ,raw.AddressPostcode
    ,0 AS Migrated
    ,'Horizon' AS ODTSourceSystem
    ,9 AS SourceSystemID -- ID for appeals in odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact
    ,raw.ingested_datetime AS IngestionDate
    ,NULL AS ValidTo
    ,md5(
        concat(
                IFNULL(raw.eventId,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.caseReference,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.eventtype,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.eventname,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.eventstatus,'.')
                ,IFNULL(CAST(raw.isurgent AS String),'.')
                ,IFNULL(CAST(raw.eventpublished AS String),'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.eventstartdatetime,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.eventenddatetime,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.notificationofsitevisit,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.addressLine1,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.addressLine2,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.addressTown,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.addressCounty,'.')
                ,IFNULL(raw.addressPostcode,'.')
    )) AS RowID
   ,CASE
        WHEN From_ODT.eventId IS NOT NULL THEN
           'N' -- Service bus is the master, never overwrite data that has come from that source. Not going this means we will end up in a perminant update process between ODT and Horizon - or updating data that should be updated in ODT not Horizon
        WHEN Newer_record.eventID IS NOT NULL THEN
            'N' -- Never overwrite newer data sets
        ELSE
            'Y'
    END AS IsActive
FROM 
    odw_standardised_db.horizon_appeals_event AS raw
    INNER JOIN (
                SELECT -- Get only the latest data for cases that haven't been migrated
                    Horizon.casenumber
                    ,Horizon.eventId
                    ,MAX(Horizon.ingested_datetime) AS Last_update
                FROM
                    odw_standardised_db.horizon_appeals_event AS Horizon
                GROUP BY
                    Horizon.casenumber
                    ,Horizon.eventId) AS Dedupe
        ON raw.casenumber = Dedupe.casenumber
        AND raw.casenumber = Dedupe.casenumber
        AND raw.ingested_datetime = Dedupe.Last_update
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT 
                        Target.eventId 
                    FROM 
                       odw_harmonised_db.sb_appeal_event AS Target 
                    WHERE 
                        Target.ODTSourceSystem = 'ODT') AS From_ODT
        ON CONCAT(raw.casenumber, '-',raw.eventId) = From_ODT.eventId
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT  
                        Target.eventId 
                        ,MAX(IngestionDate) AS Latest_Record
                    FROM 
                        odw_harmonised_db.sb_appeal_event AS Target 
                    WHERE 
                       Target.ODTSourceSystem = 'Horizon' 
                    GROUP BY
                        Target.eventId) AS Newer_record
        ON CONCAT(raw.casenumber, '-',raw.eventId) = Newer_record.eventId
        AND raw.ingested_datetime < Newer_record.Latest_Record

%%sql
-- Need to add next step of working out if we have an insert or an update and handling appropriately. For updates need to also set isActive to N on existing records
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW vw_Horizon_Event_Delta
AS
SELECT -- Step 1: Identify net new records
    raw.eventId
    ,raw.caseReference
    ,raw.eventType
    ,raw.eventName
    ,raw.eventstatus
    ,raw.isUrgent
    ,raw.eventPublished
    ,raw.eventStartDatetime
    ,raw.eventEndDatetime
    ,raw.notificationOfSitevisit
    ,raw.AddressLine1
    ,raw.AddressLine2
    ,raw.AddressTown
    ,raw.AddressCounty
    ,raw.AddressPostcode
    ,raw.Migrated
    ,raw.ODTSourceSystem
    ,raw.SourceSystemID -- ID for appeals in odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact
    ,raw.IngestionDate
    ,raw.ValidTo
    ,raw.RowID
    ,raw.IsActive
    ,'Insert' AS UpdateMode
FROM
    vw_Horizon_appeals_event AS raw
    LEFT OUTER JOIN odw_harmonised_db.sb_appeal_event AS Target 
        ON raw.eventId = Target.eventId
WHERE
    Target.eventId IS NULL
UNION -- Using union to deal with interdupes
SELECT -- Step 2: Identify records that are updates
    raw.eventId
    ,raw.caseReference
    ,raw.eventType
    ,raw.eventName
    ,raw.eventstatus
    ,raw.isUrgent
    ,raw.eventPublished
    ,raw.eventStartDatetime
    ,raw.eventEndDatetime
    ,raw.notificationOfSitevisit
    ,raw.AddressLine1
    ,raw.AddressLine2
    ,raw.AddressTown
    ,raw.AddressCounty
    ,raw.AddressPostcode
    ,raw.Migrated
    ,raw.ODTSourceSystem
    ,raw.SourceSystemID -- ID for appeals in odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact
    ,raw.IngestionDate
    ,raw.ValidTo
    ,raw.RowID
    ,raw.IsActive
    ,'Update' AS UpdateMode
FROM
    vw_Horizon_appeals_event AS raw
    INNER JOIN odw_harmonised_db.sb_appeal_event AS Target 
        ON raw.eventId = Target.eventId
        AND raw.RowID <> Target.RowID
        AND raw.IsActive = 'Y' -- Only care about updates for records that are active as we could have older records we've never seen before
        AND Target.IsActive = 'Y'
UNION -- Using union to deal with interdupes
SELECT -- Step 3: Bring records in to archive
    Target.eventId
    ,Target.caseReference
    ,Target.eventType
    ,Target.eventName
    ,Target.eventstatus
    ,CAST(Target.isUrgent AS boolean) AS isUrgent
    ,CAST(Target.eventPublished AS boolean) AS eventPublished
    ,Target.eventStartDatetime
    ,Target.eventEndDatetime
    ,Target.notificationOfSitevisit
    ,Target.AddressLine1
    ,Target.AddressLine2
    ,Target.AddressTown
    ,Target.AddressCounty
    ,Target.AddressPostcode
    ,Target.Migrated
    ,Target.ODTSourceSystem
    ,Target.SourceSystemID -- ID for appeals in odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact
    ,Target.IngestionDate
    ,to_timestamp(date_sub(raw.IngestionDate,1)) AS ValidTo
    ,Target.RowID
    ,'N' AS IsActive
    ,'Update' AS UpdateMode
FROM
    vw_Horizon_appeals_event AS raw
    INNER JOIN odw_harmonised_db.sb_appeal_event AS Target 
        ON raw.eventId = Target.eventId
        AND raw.RowID <> Target.RowID
        AND raw.IsActive = 'Y' -- Only care about updates for records that are active as we could have older records we've never seen before
        AND Target.IsActive = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT -- Lastly deal with new versions of existing events
    raw.eventId
    ,raw.caseReference
    ,raw.eventType
    ,raw.eventName
    ,raw.eventstatus
    ,raw.isUrgent
    ,raw.eventPublished
    ,raw.eventStartDatetime
    ,raw.eventEndDatetime
    ,raw.notificationOfSitevisit
    ,raw.AddressLine1
    ,raw.AddressLine2
    ,raw.AddressTown
    ,raw.AddressCounty
    ,raw.AddressPostcode
    ,raw.Migrated
    ,raw.ODTSourceSystem

-- Build comment_type_reference_dim table

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW service_user_dim_new

    AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.CaseReference IS NULL
        THEN T3.ServiceDataID
        ELSE NULL
    END AS ServiceDataID, -- surrogate key
    T1.TicketID,
    T1.CaseReference,
    'No Info' AS Salutation,
    T1.FullName,
    'No Info' AS AddressLine1,
    'No Info' AS AddressLine2,
    'No Info' AS AddressTown,
    'No Info'  AS AddressCounty,
    'No Info'  AS Postcode,
    'No Info'  AS AddressCountry,
    'No Info'  AS Organisation,
    'No Info'  AS OrganisationType,
    T1.Role,
    'No Info'  AS TelephoneNumber,
    'No Info'  AS OtherPhoneNumber,
    'No Info'  AS FaxNumber,
    T1.EmailAddress,
    T2.SourceSystemID as SourceSystemID, -- NOT CORRECT
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS IngestionDate,
    NULL AS ValidTo,
    md5(concat(IFNULL(T1.CaseReference,'.'), IFNULL(T1.TicketID,'.'), IFNULL(T1.FullName,'.'),IFNULL(T1.EmailAddress,'.'),IFNULL(T1.Role,'.'))) AS RowID,
    'Y' as IsActive,
    T3.IsActive as HistoricIsActive

FROM zendesk T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "Zendesk" = T2.Description
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.service_user_dim T3 ON T1.CaseReference = T3.CaseReference and T3.IsActive = 'Y'



WHERE
    (-- flags new data        
        (CASE
            WHEN T1.CaseReference = T3.CaseReference 
            AND md5(concat(IFNULL(T1.CaseReference,'.'), IFNULL(T1.TicketID,'.'), IFNULL(T1.FullName,'.'),IFNULL(T1.EmailAddress,'.'),IFNULL(T1.Role,'.'))) <> T3.RowID
            THEN 'Y'
            WHEN T3.ServiceDataID IS NULL
            THEN 'Y'
            ELSE 'N'
        END  = 'Y' )
    )
;

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View horizon_appeals_document_metadata_new is created

%%sql
-- Build appeals_document_metadata_new table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW appeals_document_metadata_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.CaseReference IS NULL
        THEN T3.AppealsDocumentMetadataID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS AppealsDocumentMetadataID,
    T1.documentid	AS	documentId	,
    T1.casenodeid	AS	caseId	,
    T1.casereference	AS	caseReference	,
    T1.casenumber	AS	casenumber	,
    T1.caseworktype	AS	caseType	,
    T1.caseworktypegroup	AS	caseworktypegroup	,
    T1.caseworktypeabbreviation	AS	caseworktypeabbreviation	,
    T1.version	AS	version	,
    T1.viruscheckstatus	AS	virusCheckStatus	,
    T1.redactedStatus	AS	redactedStatus	,
    T1.filename	AS	filename	,
    T1.versionfilename	AS	versionfilename	,
    T1.documenttype	AS	documentType	,
    T1.documentdescription	AS	description	,
    T1.size	AS	size	,
    T1.incomingoutgoingexternal	AS	incomingoutgoingexternal	,
    T1.datecreated	AS	dateCreated	,
    T1.lastmodified	AS	lastModified	,
    T1.datepublished	AS	datePublished	,
    T1.publishedstatus	AS	publishedstatus	,
    T1.sourcesystem	AS	sourceSystem	,
    T1.folderid	AS	horizonFolderId	,
	T1.filename	AS	originalFilename	,
	AIE.mime	AS	mime	,
	AIE.documentURI	AS	documentURI	,
	null	AS	publishedDocumentURI	,
	AIE.fileMD5	AS	fileMD5	,
	null	AS	dateReceived	,
	null	AS	origin	,
	AIE.owner	AS	owner	,
	null	AS	author	,
	null	AS	caseStage	,
    
    "0" AS Migrated,
    "Horizon" AS ODTSourceSystem,
    T2.SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.documentid	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casenodeid	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casereference	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casenumber	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.caseworktype	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.caseworktypegroup	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.caseworktypeabbreviation	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.version	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.viruscheckstatus	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.redactedStatus	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.filename	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.versionfilename	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.documenttype	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.documentdescription	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.size	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.incomingoutgoingexternal	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.datecreated	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.lastmodified	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.datepublished	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.publishedstatus	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.sourcesystem	,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.folderid	,'.'),
            IFNULL(AIE.mime	,'.'),
            IFNULL(AIE.documentURI	,'.'),
            IFNULL(AIE.fileMD5	,'.'),
            IFNULL(AIE.owner	,'.')

        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields, so needs to be done
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_appeals_document_metadata T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "Casework" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.appeals_document_metadata T3 ON T1.CaseReference = T3.CaseReference AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.aie_document_data AIE on T1.documentId = AIE.documentId AND AIE.IsActive = 'Y'

WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.CaseReference = T3.CaseReference AND 
            md5(concat(
                IFNULL(T1.documentid	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casenodeid	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casereference	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casenumber	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.caseworktype	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.caseworktypegroup	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.caseworktypeabbreviation	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.version	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.viruscheckstatus	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.redactedStatus	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.filename	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.versionfilename	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.documenttype	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.documentdescription	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.size	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.incomingoutgoingexternal	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.datecreated	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.lastmodified	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.datepublished	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.publishedstatus	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.sourcesystem	,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.folderid	,'.'),
                IFNULL(AIE.mime	,'.'),
                IFNULL(AIE.documentURI	,'.'),
                IFNULL(AIE.fileMD5	,'.'),
                IFNULL(AIE.owner	,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same key, changed data
            THEN 'Y'
            WHEN T3.CaseReference IS NULL -- new 
            THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
        END  = 'Y' ) 
    AND T1.CaseReference IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_appeals_document_metadata)

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View appeals_folder is created

%%sql
-- Build appeals_folder table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW appeals_folder_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.id IS NULL
        THEN T3.HorizonAppealFolderId
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS HorizonAppealFolderId,
    T1.id                           AS ID,
    T1.casereference	            AS CaseReference,
    T1.displaynameenglish	        AS DisplayNameEnglish,
    T1.displaynamewelsh	            AS DisplayNameWelsh,
    T1.parentfolderid	            AS ParentFolderID,
    T1.casenodeid	                AS CaseNodeId,
    T1.casestage	                AS CaseStage,
    T2.SourceSystemID               AS SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.id,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.displaynameenglish,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.displaynamewelsh,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.parentfolderid,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casenodeid,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casestage,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_appeals_folder T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 
    ON "DocumentTree" = T2.Description AND 
        T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.appeals_folder T3 
    ON T1.id = T3.ID AND 
        T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.casereference = T3.CaseReference AND md5(
            concat(
                IFNULL(T1.id,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.displaynameenglish,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.displaynamewelsh,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.parentfolderid,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casenodeid,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casestage,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same record, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.ID IS NULL -- new record
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y' )
    AND T1.id IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT(T1.id = '29309932' AND T1.casestage = 'Initial Documents') --- Hardcoded exception as per Gareth request for data consistency
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_appeals_folder)

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View casework_additional_fields_dim is created

%%sql
-- Build casework_additional_fields_dim table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW casework_additional_fields_dim_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.appealrefnumber IS NULL
        THEN T3.AdditionalFieldsID
        ELSE NULL
    END                                 AS AdditionalFieldsID,
    T1.appealrefnumber                  AS AppealRefNumber,
    T1.casereference                    AS CaseReference,
    T1.standardpriority                 AS StandardPriority,
    T1.importantinformation             AS ImportantInformation,
    T2.SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)      AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                                AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.appealrefnumber,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.standardpriority,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.importantinformation,'.')
            )
        )                               AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields, so needs to be done
    'Y'                                 AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                         AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_additional_fields T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON
        "Casework" = T2.Description AND 
        T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_additional_fields_dim T3 ON
        T1.appealrefnumber = T3.AppealRefNumber AND
        T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.appealrefnumber = T3.AppealRefNumber AND md5(
            concat(
                IFNULL(T1.appealrefnumber,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.standardpriority,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.importantinformation,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same data, changed characteristics
            THEN 'Y'
            WHEN T3.AppealRefNumber IS NULL -- new AppealRefNumber
            THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
        END  = 'Y' ) 
    AND T1.appealrefnumber IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_additional_fields)
;

%%sql

    AS

From casework_additional_fields_dim_new WHERE HistoricIsActive = 'Y' or HistoricIsActive IS NULL

    AppealRefNumber,
    CaseReference,
    StandardPriority,
    ImportantInformation,
    T1.SourceSystemID,
    T1.IngestionDate,
    T1.ValidTo,

# View casework_additional_fields_dim_changed_rows is used in a merge (Upsert) statement into the target table
- **WHEN MATCHED** ON the surrogate Key (i.e. AllAppealsID), EndDate is set to today -1 day and the IsActive flag is set to 'N'
- **WHEN NOT MATCHED** ON the surrogate Key, insert rows
## Table odw_harmonised_db.casework_additional_fields_dim is updated

%%sql
-- merge into dim table

MERGE INTO odw_harmonised_db.casework_additional_fields_dim AS Target
USING casework_additional_fields_dim_changed_rows_final AS Source

ON Source.AdditionalFieldsID = Target.AdditionalFieldsID

-- For Updates existing rows

WHEN MATCHED
    THEN 
    UPDATE SET
    Target.ValidTo = to_timestamp(ClosingDate),
    Target.IsActive = 'N'

-- Insert completely new rows
WHEN NOT MATCHED 
    THEN INSERT (
        AdditionalFieldsID,
        AppealRefNumber,
        CaseReference,
        StandardPriority,
        ImportantInformation,
        SourceSystemID,
        IngestionDate,
        ValidTo,
        RowID,
        IsActive)
    VALUES (
        Source.AdditionalFieldsID,
        Source.AppealRefNumber,
        Source.CaseReference,
        Source.StandardPriority,
        Source.ImportantInformation,
        Source.SourceSystemID,
        Source.IngestionDate,
        Source.ValidTo,
        Source.RowID,
        Source.IsActive)

-- Build casework_case_dates_dim_new table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW casework_case_dates_dim_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.appealrefnumber IS NULL
        THEN T3.CaseDatesID
        ELSE NULL
    END                     AS CaseDatesID,
    T1.appealrefnumber      AS AppealRefNumber,
    T1.casereference        AS CaseReference,
    T1.validitystatusdate   AS ValidityStatusDate,
    T2.SourceSystemID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP       AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                    AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.appealrefnumber,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.validitystatusdate,'.')
            ))              AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields, so needs to be done
    'Y'                     AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive             AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_case_dates T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "Casework" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_case_dates_dim T3 ON T1.appealrefnumber = T3.AppealRefNumber AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.appealrefnumber = T3.AppealRefNumber AND md5(
            concat(
                IFNULL(T1.appealrefnumber,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.validitystatusdate,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same employee, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.AppealRefNumber IS NULL -- new PositionCode
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y' ) 
    AND T1.appealrefnumber IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_case_dates);
;

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View casework_case_info_dim_new is created

%%sql
-- Build casework_case_info_dim_new table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW casework_case_info_dim_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.appealrefnumber IS NULL
        THEN T3.CaseInfoID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS CaseInfoID,
    T1.appealrefnumber              AS AppealRefNumber,
    T1.casereference                AS CaseReference,
    T1.Validity                     AS Validity,
    T2.SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.appealrefnumber,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.validity,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields, so needs to be done
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_case_info T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "Casework" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_case_info_dim T3 ON T1.appealrefnumber = T3.AppealRefNumber AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.appealrefnumber = T3.AppealRefNumber AND 
            md5(
                concat(
                    IFNULL(T1.appealrefnumber,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.validity,'.'))) <> T3.RowID  -- same record, changed data
            THEN 'Y'
            WHEN T3.AppealRefNumber IS NULL -- new record
            THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
        END  = 'Y' )
    AND T1.appealrefnumber IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_case_info);
;

- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'

%%sql
-- Build casework_contact_information_dim_new table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW casework_contact_information_dim_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.contactid IS NULL
        THEN T3.ContactInformationID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS ContactInformationID,
    T1.contactid                    AS ContactID,
    T1.case_number                  AS CaseNumber,
    T1.case_created_date            AS CaseCreatedDate,
    T1.typeofinvolvement            AS TypeOfInvolvement,
    T1.contacttype                  AS ContactType,
    T1.firstname                    AS FirstName,
    T1.lastname                     AS LastName,
    T1.postname                     AS PostName,
    T1.title                        AS Title,
    T1.salutation                   AS Salutation,
    T1.suffix                       AS Suffix,
    T1.pobox                        AS POBox,
    T1.address1                     AS Address1,
    T1.address2                     AS Address2,
    T1.city                         AS City,
    T1.county                       AS County,
    T1.postcode                     AS Postcode,
    T1.country                      AS Country,
    T1.telephoneoffice              AS TelephoneOffice,
    T1.telephonemobile              AS TelephoneMobile,
    T1.fax                          AS Fax,
    T1.email                        AS Email,
    T10.LPAID                       AS LPAID,
    T1.organisationname             AS OrganisationName,
    T1.organisationtypename         AS OrganisationTypeName,
    T2.SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.case_number,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.case_created_date,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.contactid,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.typeofinvolvement,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.contacttype,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.firstname,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.lastname,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.postname,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.title,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.salutation,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.suffix,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.pobox,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.address1,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.address2,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.city,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.county,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.postcode,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.country,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.telephoneoffice,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.telephonemobile,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.fax,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.email,'.'),
            IFNULL(T10.LPAID,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.organisationname,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.organisationtypename,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields, so needs to be done
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_contact_information T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "Casework" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_local_planning_authority_fact T10 ON T1.lpacode = T10.LPACode AND T10.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_contact_information_dim T3 ON T1.contactid = T3.ContactID AND
                                                                    T1.case_number = T3.CaseNumber AND
                                                                    T1.typeofinvolvement = T3.TypeOfInvolvement AND 
                                                                    T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.contactid = T3.ContactID AND 
            T1.case_number = T3.CaseNumber AND
            T1.typeofinvolvement = T3.TypeOfInvolvement AND 
        md5(
            concat(
                IFNULL(T1.case_number,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.case_created_date,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.contactid,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.typeofinvolvement,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.contacttype,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.firstname,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.lastname,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.postname,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.title,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.salutation,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.suffix,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.pobox,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.address1,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.address2,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.city,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.county,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.postcode,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.country,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.telephoneoffice,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.telephonemobile,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.fax,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.email,'.'),
                IFNULL(T10.LPAID,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.organisationname,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.organisationtypename,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same employee, changed data
            THEN 'Y'
            WHEN T3.ContactID IS NULL -- new PositionCode
            THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
        END  = 'Y')
    AND T1.contactid IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_contact_information);
;

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.appealrefnumber IS NULL
        THEN T3.InspectorCasesID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS InspectorCasesID,
    T1.appealrefnumber              AS AppealRefNumber,

    T2.SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,

    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.appealrefnumber,'.'), 
            IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.typeofinvolvement,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.inspectorname,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.contactID,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.parentkeyid,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields, so needs to be done

                IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.typeofinvolvement,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.inspectorname,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.contactID,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.parentkeyid,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same record, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.AppealRefNumber IS NULL -- new record
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y'
    AND T1.appealrefnumber IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_inspector_cases)
;

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (sap hr) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework_local_planning_authority_dim)
- **New Data:** where a Pers_No in the source does not exist as an EmployeeNumber in the target. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Pers_No in source and EmployeeNumber in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an EmployeeNumber in the target exists but the same Pers_No doesn't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View casework_local_planning_authority_dim_new is created

%%sql
-- Build casework_local_planning_authority_dim table -- merge

-- Notes - Addresses are only supplied for Inspectors - need to check inspector count against addresses data

-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW casework_local_planning_authority_dim_new 

    AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.lpa_code IS NULL
        THEN T3.LocalPlanningAuthorityID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS LocalPlanningAuthorityID, -- surrogate key
    T4.LPAID                        AS LPAID,
    T1.lpa_code                     AS LPACode,
    T1.lpa_name                     AS LPAName,
    T1.lpa_county                   AS LPACounty,
    T1.lpa_country                  AS LPACountry,
    T1.lpa_governmental_office      AS LPAGovernmentalOffice,
    T1.lpa_latitude                 AS LPALatitude,
    T1.lpa_longitude                AS LPALongitude,
    T1.type_short                   AS TypeShort,
    T1.type_long                    AS TypeLong,
    T2.SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T4.LPAID,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.lpa_code, '.'),
            IFNULL(T1.lpa_name, '.'),
            IFNULL(T1.lpa_county, '.'),
            IFNULL(T1.lpa_country,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.lpa_governmental_office,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.lpa_latitude,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.lpa_longitude,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.type_short,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.type_long,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, 
    'Y'                             AS IsActive, 
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_local_planning_authority T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "Casework" = T2.Description and T2.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_local_planning_authority_fact T4 ON T1.lpa_code = T4.LPACode AND T4.IsActive = 'Y' 
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_local_planning_authority_dim T3 ON T1.lpa_code = T3.LPACode AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    CASE
        WHEN T1.lpa_code = T3.LPACode AND 
            md5(
                concat(
                    IFNULL(T4.LPAID,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.lpa_code, '.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.lpa_name, '.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.lpa_county, '.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.lpa_country,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.lpa_governmental_office,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.lpa_latitude,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.lpa_longitude,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.type_short,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.type_long,'.')
                ))  <> T3.RowID     
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.LocalPlanningAuthorityID IS NULL
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y' 
    AND T1.lpa_code IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_local_planning_authority)
;

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.LPACode IS NULL
        THEN T3.LPAResponsibilityID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS LPAResponsibilityID,
    T1.lpacode                      AS LPACode,

    T1.login                        AS Login,

    T1.workflow                     AS Workflow,
    T2.SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.lpacode,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.lpaname,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.appealtype,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.login,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.employeeid,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.caseofficername,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.workflow,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_lpa_responsibility T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "Casework" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_local_planning_authority_fact T4 ON T1.lpacode = T4.LPACode AND T4.IsActive = 'Y' 
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_lpa_responsibility_dim T3 ON T1.lpacode = T3.LPACode AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    CASE
        WHEN T1.lpacode = T3.LPACode AND 
            md5(
                concat(
                    IFNULL(T1.lpacode,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.lpaname,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.appealtype,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.login,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.employeeid,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.caseofficername,'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.workflow,'.')
                )
            ) <> T3.RowID  -- same record, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.LPACode IS NULL -- new record
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y'
    AND T1.LPACode IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_lpa_responsibility)

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View casework_nsip_examination_timetable_dim_new is created

%%sql
-- Build casework_nsip_examination_timetable_dim_new table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW casework_nsip_examination_timetable_dim_new 

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.CaseReference IS NULL
        THEN T3.NSIPExaminationTimetableID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS NSIPExaminationTimetableID,
    T1.id                           AS ID,
    T1.casereference                AS CaseReference,
    T1.typeofexamination            AS TypeOfExamination,
    T1.name                         AS Name,
    T1.description                  AS Description,
    T1.deadlinestartdatetime        AS DeadlineStartDateTime,
    T1.date                         AS Date,
    T1.location                     AS Location,
    null                            AS EventLineItems,
    "0"                             AS Migrated,
    T3.Published                    AS Published,
    "Horizon"                       AS ODTSourceSystem,
    T2.SourceSystemID               AS SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.id,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.typeofexamination,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.name,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.description,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.deadlinestartdatetime,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.date,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.location,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_examination_timetable T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "Casework" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_nsip_examination_timetable_dim T3 ON T1.casereference = T3.CaseReference AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.casereference = T3.CaseReference AND md5(
            concat(
                IFNULL(T1.id,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.typeofexamination,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.name,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.description,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.deadlinestartdatetime,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.date,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.location,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same row, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.CaseReference IS NULL -- new CaseReference
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y')
    AND T1.CaseReference IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_examination_timetable)
