-- Build casework_nsip_redactions_dim table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW casework_nsip_redactions_dim_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.case_reference IS NULL
        THEN T3.NSIPRedactionsID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS NSIPRedactionsID,
    T1.case_reference               AS CaseReference,
    T1.num_redactions               AS NumberOfRedactions,
    T2.SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.case_reference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.case_reference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.num_redactions,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_nsip_redactions T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "Casework" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_nsip_redactions_dim T3 ON T1.case_reference = T3.CaseReference AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.case_reference = T3.CaseReference AND md5(
            concat(
                IFNULL(T1.case_reference,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.case_reference,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.num_redactions,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same record, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.CaseReference IS NULL -- new record
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y' )
    AND T1.case_reference IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_nsip_redactions)
;

- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View casework_special_circumstance_dim_new is created

%%sql
-- Build casework_special_circumstance_dim_new table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW casework_special_circumstance_dim_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.appealrefnumber IS NULL
        THEN T3.SpecialCircumstanceID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS SpecialCircumstanceID,
    T1.appealrefnumber              AS AppealRefNumber,
    to_date(T1.lastmodified)        AS LastModified,
    T1.specialcircumstance          AS SpecialCircumstance,
    T2.SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.appealrefnumber,'.'),
            IFNULL(to_date(T1.lastmodified),'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.specialcircumstance,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_special_circumstance T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "Casework" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.casework_special_circumstance_dim T3 ON T1.appealrefnumber = T3.AppealRefNumber AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.appealrefnumber = T3.AppealRefNumber AND 
            md5(
                concat(
                    IFNULL(T1.appealrefnumber,'.'),
                    IFNULL(to_date(T1.lastmodified),'.'),
                    IFNULL(T1.specialcircumstance,'.')
                )
            ) <> T3.RowID  -- existing record, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.AppealRefNumber IS NULL -- new record
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y')
    AND T1.appealrefnumber IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_special_circumstance)
;

    CASE

        THEN T3.ProcedureReferenceID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS ProcedureReferenceID, -- surrogate key
    T1.id                           AS ProcedureID,
    T1.value                        AS Value,
    T2.SourceSystemID               AS SourceSystemID, 
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(

FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.checkmark_procedure_reference_dim T3

- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (sap hr) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.checkmark_comments_fact)
- **New Data:** where a Pers_No in the source does not exist as an EmployeeNumber in the target. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Pers_No in source and EmployeeNumber in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an EmployeeNumber in the target exists but the same Pers_No doesn't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View checkmark_case_reading_case_bridge__new is created

%%sql  

-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW checkmark_case_reading_case_bridge_new 

    AS

-- gets data that matches of CaseReference and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT 
    T1.CommentsDimID                AS CommentsDimID,
    T1.CaseReference                AS CaseReference, 
    T1.StateReferenceID             AS StateReferenceID,
    T1.TypeReferenceID              AS TypeReferenceID,
    T2.SourceSystemID               AS SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.CaseReference,'.'), 
            IFNULL(T1.StateReferenceID,'.'), 
            IFNULL(T1.TypeReferenceID,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID,
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T1.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_harmonised_db.checkmark_case_reading_case_bridge T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "SAP HR" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.checkmark_reading_case_fact T3 ON T3.ReadingCaseID = T1.ReadingCaseID and T3.IsActive= 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.checkmark_case_fact T4 ON T4.CaseID = T1.CaseID and T4.IsActive= 'Y'

WHERE
    -- flags new data        
        (   CASE
                WHEN T1.CaseReference = T1.CaseReference AND md5(concat(IFNULL(T1.CaseReference,'.'), IFNULL(T1.StateReferenceID,'.'), IFNULL(T1.TypeReferenceID,'.'))) <> T1.RowID    -- same employee, changed data
                THEN 'Y'
                WHEN T1.CaseReference IS NULL -- new employee
                THEN 'Y'
                ELSE 'N'
            END  = 'Y' )
    AND T1.CaseReference IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM procedure_reference_grouped)

def test_table_exists(db_name: str, table_name: str) -> bool:
    spark.sql(f"USE {db_name}")
    tables_df: DataFrame = spark.sql("SHOW TABLES")
    table_names: list = [row['tableName'] for row in tables_df.collect()]
    return table_name in table_names
if test_table_exists(db_name, table_name):
mssparkutils.notebook.exit('')

def get_incremental_key(entity_name: str, storage_account: str, path_to_orchestration_file: str) -> str:
    # getting the incremental key from the odw-config/orchestration
    df: DataFrame = spark.read.option("multiline","true").json(path_to_orchestration_file)
    definitions: list = json.loads(df.toJSON().first())['definitions']
    definition: dict = next((d for d in definitions if entity_name == d['Source_Filename_Start']), None)
    return definition['Harmonised_Incremental_Key'] if definition and 'Harmonised_Incremental_Key' in definition else None

def create_spark_schema(db_name: str, entity_name: str) -> StructType:
    incremental_key: str = get_incremental_key(entity_name, storage_account, path_to_orchestration_file) if db_name == 'odw_harmonised_db' else None
    schema = mssparkutils.notebook.run("/py_create_spark_schema", 30, {"db_name": db_name, "entity_name": entity_name, "incremental_key": incremental_key, "is_servicebus_schema": is_servicebus_schema})
    spark_schema = StructType.fromJson(json.loads(schema))
    return spark_schema
spark_dataframe = create_spark_dataframe()
create_spark_table(db_name, table_name, spark_dataframe)
test_table_exists(db_name, table_name)

source: # Notebook to create a view and table for the DaRT API query

A view is created combining case data from multiple tables. This query is not performant enough to be used in an API call, hance the creation of a table in odw_curated_db as well. The table will be populated from the view on a regular basis and the API will query the table, allowing for much faster response times.

All columns have been cast to string / varchar(max) due to some errors when creating the table due to datetime columns.

The API repsonse will convert the data into json format to be further processed by the DaRT application.

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View document_case_reference_dim is created

%%sql
-- Build document_case_reference_dim table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW document_case_reference_dim_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.casereference IS NULL
        THEN T3.DocumentCaseReferenceID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS DocumentCaseReferenceID,
    T1.CaseUniqueId                 AS CaseUniqueId,
    T1.CaseNodeId                   AS CaseNodeId,
    T1.CaseReference                AS CaseReference,
    T1.CaseParentId                 AS CaseParentId,
    T1.CaseCreateDate               AS CaseCreateDate,
    T1.CaseCloseDate                AS CaseCloseDate,
    T1.CaseCloseStatus              AS CaseCloseStatus,
    T1.CaseOwnerId                  AS CaseOwnerId,
    T1.ChangeTypeStartedAt          AS ChangeTypeStartedAt,
    T1.ChangeTypeStartedBy          AS ChangeTypeStartedBy,
    T1.CaseTypeId                   AS CaseTypeId,
    T1.CaseLockedAt                 AS CaseLockedAt,
    T1.CaseLockedBy                 AS CaseLockedBy,
    T1.CaseLockedFor                AS CaseLockedFor,
    T2.SourceSystemID               AS SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.CaseUniqueId,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseNodeId,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseReference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseParentId,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseCreateDate,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseCloseDate,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseCloseStatus,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseOwnerId,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.ChangeTypeStartedAt,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.ChangeTypeStartedBy,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseTypeId,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseLockedAt,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseLockedBy,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.CaseLockedFor,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.document_case_reference T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 
    ON "DocumentTree" = T2.Description AND 
        T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.document_case_reference_dim T3 
    ON T1.casereference = T3.CaseReference AND 
        T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.casereference = T3.CaseReference AND md5(
            concat(
                IFNULL(T1.CaseUniqueId,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseNodeId,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseReference,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseParentId,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseCreateDate,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseCloseDate,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseCloseStatus,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseOwnerId,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.ChangeTypeStartedAt,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.ChangeTypeStartedBy,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseTypeId,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseLockedAt,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseLockedBy,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.CaseLockedFor,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same record, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.CaseReference IS NULL -- new record
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y' )
    AND T1.casereference IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.document_case_reference)

%%sql
-- Create new and updated dataset

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW document_case_reference_dim_changed_rows

    AS

-- gets updated, deleted and new rows

    CaseCreateDate,
    CaseCloseDate,

# View document_case_reference_dim_changed_rows is used in a merge (Upsert) statement into the target table
- **WHEN MATCHED** ON the surrogate Key (i.e. AllAppealsID), EndDate is set to today -1 day and the IsActive flag is set to 'N'
- **WHEN NOT MATCHED** ON the surrogate Key, insert rows
## Table odw_harmonised_db.document_case_reference_dim is updated

%%sql
-- merge into dim table

MERGE INTO odw_harmonised_db.document_case_reference_dim AS Target
USING document_case_reference_dim_changed_rows_final AS Source

ON Source.DocumentCaseReferenceID = Target.DocumentCaseReferenceID

-- For Updates existing rows

WHEN MATCHED
    THEN 
    UPDATE SET
    Target.ValidTo = to_timestamp(ClosingDate),
    Target.IsActive = 'N'

-- Insert completely new rows

WHEN NOT MATCHED 
    THEN INSERT (
        DocumentCaseReferenceID,
        CaseUniqueId,
        CaseNodeId,
        CaseReference,
        CaseParentId,
        CaseCreateDate,
        CaseCloseDate,
        CaseCloseStatus,
        CaseOwnerId,
        ChangeTypeStartedAt,
        ChangeTypeStartedBy,
        CaseTypeId,
        CaseLockedAt,
        CaseLockedBy,
        CaseLockedFor,
        SourceSystemID,
        IngestionDate,
        ValidTo,
        RowID,
        IsActive)
    VALUES (
        Source.DocumentCaseReferenceID,
        Source.CaseUniqueId,
        Source.CaseNodeId,
        Source.CaseReference,
        Source.CaseParentId,
        Source.CaseCreateDate,
        Source.CaseCloseDate,
        Source.CaseCloseStatus,
        Source.CaseOwnerId,
        Source.ChangeTypeStartedAt,
        Source.ChangeTypeStartedBy,
        Source.CaseTypeId,
        Source.CaseLockedAt,
        Source.CaseLockedBy,
        Source.CaseLockedFor,
        Source.SourceSystemID,
        Source.IngestionDate,
        Source.ValidTo,
        Source.RowID,
        Source.IsActive)

- View **casework_all_appeals_new** is unioned to the target data filter to only those rows where changes have been detected
## View document_case_type_dim_changed_rows is created

%%sql
-- Create new and updated dataset

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW document_case_type_dim_changed_rows

    AS

-- gets updated, deleted and new rows 
SELECT 
    DocumentCaseTypeID,
    DisplayOrder,
    Abbreviation,
    SubtypeID,
    Name,
    DisplayName,
    AppTypeGrp,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    CaseworkType,
    BinderId,
    ReferencePrefix,
    TemplateName,
    SourceSystemID,
    IngestionDate,
    ValidTo,
    RowID,
    IsActive
    

From document_case_type_dim_new WHERE HistoricIsActive = 'Y' or HistoricIsActive IS NULL

    UNION ALL

-- gets original versions of updated rows so we can update EndDate and set IsActive flag to 'N'
SELECT
    DocumentCaseTypeID,
    DisplayOrder,
    Abbreviation,
    SubtypeID,
    Name,
    DisplayName,
    AppTypeGrp,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    CaseworkType,
    BinderId,
    ReferencePrefix,
    TemplateName,
    SourceSystemID,
    IngestionDate,
    ValidTo,
    RowID,
    IsActive
    
FROM odw_harmonised_db.document_case_type_dim
WHERE Abbreviation IN (SELECT Abbreviation FROM document_case_type_dim_new WHERE DocumentCaseTypeID IS NULL) AND IsActive = 'Y';

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW Loading_month

    AS

SELECT DISTINCT
    IngestionDate AS IngestionDate,
    to_timestamp(date_sub(IngestionDate,1)) AS ClosingDate,
    'Y' AS IsActive

FROM document_case_type_dim_new;

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW document_case_type_dim_changed_rows_final

    AS

SELECT 
    DocumentCaseTypeID,
    DisplayOrder,
    Abbreviation,
    SubtypeID,
    Name,
    DisplayName,
    AppTypeGrp,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    CaseworkType,
    BinderId,
    ReferencePrefix,
    TemplateName,
    T1.IngestionDate,
    T1.ValidTo,
    T1.RowID,
    T1.IsActive,
    T2.ClosingDate
FROM document_case_type_dim_changed_rows T1
FULL JOIN Loading_month T2 ON T1.IsActive = T2.IsActive

# View document_case_type_dim_changed_rows is used in a merge (Upsert) statement into the target table
- **WHEN MATCHED** ON the surrogate Key (i.e. AllAppealsID), EndDate is set to today -1 day and the IsActive flag is set to 'N'
- **WHEN NOT MATCHED** ON the surrogate Key, insert rows
## Table odw_harmonised_db.document_case_type_dim is updated

%%sql
-- merge into dim table

MERGE INTO odw_harmonised_db.document_case_type_dim AS Target
USING document_case_type_dim_changed_rows_final AS Source

ON Source.DocumentCaseTypeID = Target.DocumentCaseTypeID

-- For Updates existing rows

WHEN MATCHED
    THEN 
    UPDATE SET
    Target.ValidTo = to_timestamp(ClosingDate),
    Target.IsActive = 'N'

-- Insert completely new rows

WHEN NOT MATCHED 
    THEN INSERT (
        DocumentCaseTypeID,
        DisplayOrder,
        Abbreviation,
        SubtypeID,
        Name,
        DisplayName,
        AppTypeGrp,
        StartDate,
        EndDate,
        CaseworkType,
        BinderId,
        ReferencePrefix,
        TemplateName,
        SourceSystemID,
        IngestionDate,
        ValidTo,
        RowID,
        IsActive)
    VALUES (
        Source.DocumentCaseTypeID,
        Source.DisplayOrder,
        Source.Abbreviation,
        Source.SubtypeID,
        Source.Name,
        Source.DisplayName,
        Source.AppTypeGrp,
        Source.StartDate,
        Source.EndDate,
        Source.CaseworkType,
        Source.BinderId,
        Source.ReferencePrefix,
        Source.TemplateName,
        Source.SourceSystemID,
        Source.IngestionDate,
        Source.ValidTo,
        Source.RowID,
        Source.IsActive)

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

    1. Create a new record for completely new records that we've never seen before (including updates to existing records), 
    2. Unarchive records we've seen before and have become the latest info we want
    3. Archive records off that are not part of our net new

    First, we identify net new records
*/
SELECT
    NULL AS DocumentMetaDataID
    ,standardised.dataid AS DataID
    ,standardised.casenodeid AS CaseNodeID
    ,standardised.casereference AS CaseReference
    ,standardised.documentreference AS DocumentReference
    ,standardised.version AS Version

    ,standardised.documenttype AS DocumentType
    ,standardised.sourcesystem AS SourceSystem
    ,standardised.author AS Author
    ,standardised.representative AS Representative
    ,standardised.documentdescription AS DocumentDescription
    ,standardised.documentcasestage AS DocumentCaseStage
    ,standardised.filter1 AS Filter1
    ,standardised.filter2 AS Filter2
    ,standardised.parentID AS ParentID
    ,"0" AS Migrated
    ,"Horizon" AS ODTSourceSystem
    ,system_config.SourceSystemID AS SourceSystemID
    ,to_timestamp(standardised.expected_from) AS IngestionDate
    ,NULL AS ValidTo
    ,md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(standardised.dataid,'.'),
            IFNULL(standardised.casenodeid,'.'),
            IFNULL(standardised.casereference,'.'),
            IFNULL(standardised.documentreference,'.'),
            IFNULL(standardised.version,'.'),
            IFNULL(standardised.name,'.'),
            IFNULL(standardised.datasize	,'.'),

            IFNULL(standardised.filter2,'.'),
            IFNULL(standardised.parentID,'.')
        )) AS RowID -- this hash should contain all the defining fields
    ,'Y' AS IsActive
    ,NULL AS HistoricIsActive
FROM
    odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact AS system_config
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            dataID
            ,Version
            ,name
            ,MAX(expected_from) AS Last_update -- This is the PK on the table due to one dataID covering multiple files, and needing to return all versions
        FROM
            odw_standardised_db.document_meta_data

        ON System_config.Description = "DocumentTree"
        AND system_config.IsActive = 'Y'
    INNER JOIN odw_standardised_db.document_meta_data AS standardised
        ON Latest.dataID = standardised.dataId
        AND Latest.Version = standardised.Version
        AND Latest.name = standardised.name
        AND Latest.Last_update = standardised.expected_from
    LEFT OUTER JOIN odw_harmonised_db.document_meta_data AS Harmonised
        ON YEAR(standardised.CreateDate)  = Harmonised.Year
        AND standardised.DataID = Harmonised.DataID  
        AND standardised.Version = Harmonised.Version 
        AND standardised.name = Harmonised.name 
        AND md5(
                concat(
                        IFNULL(standardised.dataid,'.'),
                        IFNULL(standardised.casenodeid,'.'),
                        IFNULL(standardised.casereference,'.'),
                        IFNULL(standardised.documentreference,'.'),
                        IFNULL(standardised.version,'.'),

                    )
                ) = Harmonised.RowID 
WHERE

UNION
-- Next get records that we have seen, but are incorrectly set to archived

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

def test_table_exists(db_name: str, table_name: str) -> bool:
    spark.sql(f"USE {db_name}")
    tables_df: DataFrame = spark.sql("SHOW TABLES")
    table_names: list = [row['tableName'] for row in tables_df.collect()]
    return table_name in table_names

def get_incremental_key(entity_id: int, storage_account: str, path_to_orchestration_file: str) -> str:
    # getting the incremental key from the odw-config/orchestration
    df: DataFrame = spark.read.option("multiline","true").json(path_to_orchestration_file)
    definitions: list = json.loads(df.toJSON().first())['definitions']
    definition: dict = next((d for d in definitions if entity_id == d['Source_ID']), None)
    return definition['Harmonised_Incremental_Key'] if definition and 'Harmonised_Incremental_Key' in definition else None

def create_spark_schema(db_name: str, entity_name: str) -> StructType:
    incremental_key: str = get_incremental_key(entity_id, storage_account, path_to_orchestration_file) if db_name == 'odw_harmonised_db' else None
    schema = mssparkutils.notebook.run("/py_create_spark_schema", 30, {"db_name": db_name, "entity_name": entity_name, "incremental_key": incremental_key, "is_servicebus_schema": False})
    spark_schema = StructType.fromJson(json.loads(schema))
    return spark_schema

def create_spark_dataframe() -> DataFrame:
    spark_dataframe: DataFrame = spark.createDataFrame([], schema=create_spark_schema(db_name, entity_name))
    return spark_dataframe

def create_spark_table(db_name: str, table_name: str, spark_dataframe: DataFrame) -> None:
    spark_dataframe.write.format("delta").saveAsTable(f"{db_name}.{table_name}")
    print("Table created")

- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View entraid_new is created

%%sql
-- Build entraid_new table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW entraid_new 

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.id IS NULL
        THEN T2.EmployeeEntraId
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS EmployeeEntraId,
    T1.id                           AS id,
    T1.employeeId                   AS employeeId,
    T1.givenName                    AS givenName,
    T1.surname                      AS surname,
    T1.userPrincipalName            AS userPrincipalName,
    "0"                             AS Migrated,
    "EntraID"                       AS ODTSourceSystem,
    T3.SourceSystemID               AS SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.id,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.employeeId,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.givenName,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.surname,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.userPrincipalName,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T2.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.entraid T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T3 ON "SAP HR" = T3.Description AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.entraid T2 ON T1.id = T2.id AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.id = T2.id AND md5(
            concat(
                IFNULL(T1.id,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.employeeId,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.givenName,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.surname,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.userPrincipalName,'.')
            )) <> T2.RowID  -- same row, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T2.id IS NULL -- new employeeId
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y')
    AND T1.id IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.entraid)

%%sql
-- Create new and updated dataset

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW entraid_changed_rows

    AS

-- gets updated, deleted and new rows 
Select

    id,

SELECT

    id,
    employeeId,
    givenName,
    surname,
    userPrincipalName,

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW Loading_month

    AS

SELECT DISTINCT
    IngestionDate AS IngestionDate,
    to_timestamp(date_sub(IngestionDate,1)) AS ClosingDate,
    'Y' AS IsActive

FROM entraid_new;

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW entraid_changed_rows_final

    AS

SELECT 
    EmployeeEntraId,
    id,
    employeeId,
    givenName,
    surname,
    userPrincipalName,
    Migrated,
    ODTSourceSystem,
    T1.SourceSystemID,
    T1.IngestionDate,
    T1.ValidTo,
    T1.RowID,
    T1.IsActive,
    T2.ClosingDate
FROM entraid_changed_rows T1
FULL JOIN Loading_month T2 ON T1.IsActive = T2.IsActive

# View entraid_changed_rows is used in a merge (Upsert) statement into the target table
- **WHEN MATCHED** ON the surrogate Key (i.e. EmployeeEntraId), EndDate is set to today -1 day and the IsActive flag is set to 'N'
- **WHEN NOT MATCHED** ON the surrogate Key, insert rows
## Table odw_harmonised_db.entraid is updated

%%sql

-- merge into dim table
MERGE INTO odw_harmonised_db.entraid AS Target
USING entraid_changed_rows_final AS Source

ON Source.id = Target.id AND Target.IsActive = 'Y'

-- For Updates existing rows

WHEN MATCHED
    THEN 
    UPDATE SET
    Target.ValidTo = to_timestamp(ClosingDate),
    Target.IsActive = 'N'

-- Insert completely new rows

WHEN NOT MATCHED 
    THEN INSERT (
        EmployeeEntraId,
        id,
        employeeId,
        givenName,
        surname,
        userPrincipalName,
        Migrated,
        ODTSourceSystem,
        SourceSystemID,
        IngestionDate,
        ValidTo,

    VALUES (
        Source.EmployeeEntraId,

        Source.Migrated,
        Source.ODTSourceSystem,

    employeeId,    
    id,
    givenName,
    surname,
    userPrincipalName,
    Migrated,
    ODTSourceSystem,
    SourceSystemID,
    IngestionDate,

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

%%sql
-- Build horizon_appeals_folder table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW horizon_appeals_folder_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.id IS NULL
        THEN T3.HorizonAppealFolderId
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS HorizonAppealFolderId,
    T1.id                           AS ID,
    T1.casereference	            AS CaseReference,
    T1.displaynameenglish	        AS DisplayNameEnglish,
    T1.displaynamewelsh	            AS DisplayNameWelsh,
    T1.parentfolderid	            AS ParentFolderID,
    T1.casenodeid	                AS CaseNodeId,
    T1.casestage	                AS CaseStage,
    T2.SourceSystemID               AS SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.id,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.displaynameenglish,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.displaynamewelsh,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.parentfolderid,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casenodeid,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casestage,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_appeals_folder T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 
    ON "DocumentTree" = T2.Description AND 
        T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.horizon_appeals_folder T3 
    ON T1.id = T3.ID AND 
        T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.casereference = T3.CaseReference AND md5(
            concat(
                IFNULL(T1.id,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.displaynameenglish,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.displaynamewelsh,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.parentfolderid,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casenodeid,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casestage,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same record, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.ID IS NULL -- new record
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y' )
    AND T1.id IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT(T1.id = '29309932' AND T1.casestage = 'Initial Documents') --- Hardcoded exception as per Gareth request for data consistency
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_appeals_folder)

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

## View horizon_folder is created

%%sql
-- Build horizon_folder table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW horizon_folder_new

     AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.id IS NULL
        THEN T3.HorizonFolderID
        ELSE NULL
    END                             AS HorizonFolderID,
    T1.id                           AS ID,
    T1.casereference	            AS CaseReference,
    T1.displaynameenglish	        AS DisplayNameEnglish,
    T1.displaynamewelsh	            AS DisplayNameWelsh,
    T1.parentfolderid	            AS ParentFolderID,
    T1.casenodeid	                AS CaseNodeId,
    T1.casestage	                AS CaseStage,
    T2.SourceSystemID               AS SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)  AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                            AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.id,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.displaynameenglish,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.displaynamewelsh,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.parentfolderid,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casenodeid,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.casestage,'.')
        ))                          AS RowID, -- this hash should contain all the defining fields
    'Y'                             AS IsActive,
    T3.IsActive                     AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_folder T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 
    ON "DocumentTree" = T2.Description AND 
        T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.horizon_folder T3 
    ON T1.id = T3.ID AND 
        T3.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.casereference = T3.CaseReference AND md5(
            concat(
                IFNULL(T1.id,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casereference,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.displaynameenglish,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.displaynamewelsh,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.parentfolderid,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casenodeid,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.casestage,'.')
            )) <> T3.RowID  -- same record, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T3.ID IS NULL -- new record
        THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y' )
    AND T1.id IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT(T1.id = '29309932' AND T1.casestage = 'Initial Documents') --- Hardcoded exception as per Gareth request for data consistency
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.horizon_folder)

        First(Work_Contract) as Description, 
        CASE 
            WHEN CT IS NULL
            THEN 'N/A'

        END as ContractTypeCode,

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW contract_dim_new

    AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.ContractCode IS NULL
        THEN T7.ContractID
        ELSE NULL
    END as ContractID, 
    T1.ContractCode,
    T1.Description,
    T1.ContractTypeCode,
    T1.ContractType,
    T2.SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from) AS IngestionDate,
    NULL AS ValidTo,
    md5(
        concat(
            IFNULL(T1.ContractCode,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.Description,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.ContractTypeCode,'.'),
            IFNULL(T1.ContractType,'.'))) AS RowID,
    'Y' AS IsActive,
    T7.IsActive AS HistoricIsActive

FROM contract_grouped T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "SAP HR" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_contract_dim T7 ON T1.ContractCode = T7.ContractCode AND
                                                T1.ContractTypeCode = T7.ContractTypeCode AND 
                                                T7.IsActive = 'Y'     
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    CASE
        WHEN T1.ContractCode = T7.ContractCode AND
            T1.ContractTypeCode = T7.ContractTypeCode
            AND md5(concat(IFNULL(T1.ContractCode,'.'), IFNULL(T1.Description,'.'), IFNULL(T1.ContractTypeCode,'.'), IFNULL(T1.ContractType,'.'))) <> T7.RowID   -- same employee, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T7.ContractCode IS NULL -- new contract code
        THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y'

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW hr_employee_leavers_dim_new

    AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"
SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T3.EmployeeID IS NULL
        THEN T7.EmployeeLeaversID
        ELSE NULL
    END                     AS EmployeeLeaversID,     
    T1.Pers_No              AS EmployeeID,
    T1.Pers_No              AS EmployeeNumber,
    T1.Reason_For_Action    AS ReasonForLeaving, 
    CASE 
        WHEN T1.Org_Start_Date = '00/00/0000'
        THEN '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
        ELSE T1.Org_Start_Date
    END                     AS EmploymentStartDate,
    T1.Leaving              AS EmploymentEndDate,
    T1.Act                  AS Act,
    T1.Action_Type           AS ActionType,
    T1.ActR                 AS ActR,
    T1.S                    AS S,
    T1.User_ID              AS UserID,
    T1.WorkC                AS WorkC,
    T2.SourceSystemID       AS SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from) AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                    AS ValidTo,
    md5(concat(
        IFNULL(T3.EmployeeID,'.'),
        IFNULL(T1.Reason_For_Action,'.'),
        IFNULL(CAST(T1.Leaving AS String),'.'),
        IFNULL(T1.Act,'.'),
        IFNULL(T1.ActR,'.'),
        IFNULL(T1.S,'.'),
        IFNULL(T1.User_ID,'.'))) as RowID,
    'Y' as IsActive,
    T7.IsActive as HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.vw_leavers T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "SAP HR" = T2.Description
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_employee_fact T3 ON T1.Pers_No = T3.PersNumber AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_employee_leavers_dim T7 ON   T3.EmployeeID = T7.EmployeeID AND 
                                                        CAST(T1.Leaving AS DATE) = CAST(T7.EmploymentEndDate AS DATE) AND 
                                                        T7.IsActive = 'Y'

WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T3.EmployeeID = T7.EmployeeID AND 
            CAST(T1.Leaving AS DATE) = CAST(T7.EmploymentEndDate AS DATE) AND
            md5(concat(
                IFNULL(T3.EmployeeID,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.Reason_For_Action,'.'),
                IFNULL(CAST(T1.Leaving AS String),'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.Act,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.ActR,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.S,'.'),
                IFNULL(T1.User_ID,'.'))) <> T7.RowID  -- same employee, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T7.EmployeeID IS NULL -- new employee
        THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y')

     AS

FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_position_dim T7 ON T1.PositionCode = T7.PositionCode AND T7.IsActive = 'Y'

    -- flags new data        
    CASE
        WHEN T1.PositionCode = T7.PositionCode AND md5(concat(IFNULL(T1.PositionCode,'.'), IFNULL(T1.Description,'.'))) <> T7.RowID  -- same employee, changed data

LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_employeegroup_dim T13 ON T1.EEGrp = T13.EEGrp and T13.IsActive = 'Y'

LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T14 ON "SAP HR" = T14.Description AND T14.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_record_fact T15 ON T1.Pers_No = T15.EmployeeID AND T15.IsActive = 'Y'

WHERE

            IFNULL(T11.LocationID, '.'),IFNULL(T12.WorkScheduleID, '.'),IFNULL(T13.EmployeeGroupID, '.'),IFNULL(T13b.PayrollAreaID, '.'))) <> T15.RowID
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T15.EmployeeID IS NULL
        THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y'
    )
    AND T2.EmployeeID IS NOT NULL

    AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"

SELECT DISTINCT

    'Y' as IsActive,
    T7.IsActive as HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.vw_protected_characteristics T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "SAP HR" = T2.Description AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'

    -- flags new data        
    (CASE
        WHEN T1.Ref_No = T7.SourceID AND md5(concat(IFNULL(T1.Ref_No,'.'), IFNULL(T3.DisabilityID,'.'), IFNULL(T4.DiversityID,'.'), IFNULL(T5.ReligionID,'.'), IFNULL(T6.SXOID,'.'))) <> T7.RowID    -- same employee, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T7.SourceID IS NULL -- new employee
        THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y')
    AND T1.Ref_No IS NOT NULL
;

- **New Data:** where a PA in the source does not exist as an Work_Schedule_Rule in the target. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on PA in source and Work_Schedule_Rule in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'

## View workschedule_dim_new is created

%%sql
-- Build workschedule_dim table
-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW workschedule_dim_new

    AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.Work_Schedule_Rule IS NULL
        THEN first(T7.WorkScheduleID)
        ELSE NULL
    END as WorkScheduleID, -- surrogate key
    Work_Schedule_Rule AS WorkScheduleRule, -- source system id
    WkDys AS WorkWeekDays,
    Wk_hrs AS WorkWeekHours,
    Hrs_Day AS WorkDayHours, 
    First(T2.SourceSystemID) as SourceSystemID,
    First(to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)) AS IngestionDate,
    NULL AS ValidTo,
    md5(concat(IFNULL(T1.Work_Schedule_Rule,'.'), IFNULL(T1.WkDys,'.'),IFNULL(T1.Wk_hrs,'.'),IFNULL(T1.Hrs_Day,'.'))) as RowID,
    'Y' as IsActive,
    First(T7.IsActive) as HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.vw_absences T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 ON "SAP HR" = T2.Description and T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_work_schedule_dim T7 ON T1.Work_Schedule_Rule = T7.WorkScheduleRule AND
                                                    T1.WkDys = T7.WorkWeekDays AND
                                                    T1.Wk_hrs = T7.WorkWeekHours AND
                                                    T1.Hrs_Day = T7.WorkDayHours AND 
                                                    T7.IsActive = 'Y'
WHERE
    -- flags new data        
    CASE
        WHEN T1.Work_Schedule_Rule = T7.WorkScheduleRule AND
            T1.WkDys = T7.WorkWeekDays AND
            T1.Wk_hrs = T7.WorkWeekHours AND
            T1.Hrs_Day = T7.WorkDayHours AND
            md5(concat(IFNULL(T1.Work_Schedule_Rule,'.'), IFNULL(T1.WkDys,'.'),IFNULL(T1.Wk_hrs,'.'),IFNULL(T1.Hrs_Day,'.'))) <> T7.RowID   -- same employee, changed data
        THEN 'Y'
        WHEN T7.WorkScheduleRule IS NULL -- new work schedule
        THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END  = 'Y' 
GROUP BY T1.Work_Schedule_Rule, T1.WkDys, T1.Wk_hrs, T1.Hrs_Day;

        IFNULL(T1.deleted,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.description,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.modified_by_name,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.modified_user_id,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.modified_user_link,'.')))                                     AS RowID, 
    'Y'                                                                         AS IsActive, 
    T3.IsActive                                                                 AS HistoricIsActive

LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2

                        IFNULL(T1.assigned_user_id,'.'),

                        IFNULL(T1.assigned_user_name,'.'),

    END                                     AS IMSEntityID, -- surrogate key

LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2

                        IFNULL(T1.information_owner_c,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.user_id1_c,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.information_expert_c,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.type,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.status,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.priority,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.resolution,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.work_log,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.business_criticality,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.date_modified,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.SecurityGroups,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.assigned_user_id,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.assigned_user_link,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.assigned_user_name,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.created_by,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.created_by_link,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.created_by_name,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.date_entered,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.deleted,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.description,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.help,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.modified_by_name,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.modified_user_id,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.modified_user_link,'.'))) <> T3.RowID     
            THEN 'Y'
            WHEN T3.IMSEntityID IS NULL
            THEN 'Y'
            ELSE 'N'
        END  = 'Y' )
    AND T1.ims_bdc_entity_number IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.ims_entity_new);

-- Build listed_building_dim table -- merge

-- Notes - Addresses are only supplied for Inspectors - need to check inspector count against addresses data

-- Gets modified or deleted from source rows

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW listed_building_dim_new 

    AS

-- gets data that matches of SourceID and flags that it is modified based on a row (md5) hash. Flags as "NewData"
-- gets data that is in the target but not in source. Flags as "DeletedData"

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN T1.reference IS NULL
        THEN T3.ListedBuildingID
        ELSE NULL
    END                                         AS ListedBuildingID, -- surrogate key
    IFNULL(T1.entity,'No Info')                 AS ListedBuildingEntity,
    IFNULL(T1.entry_date,'No Info')             AS ListedBuildingEntryDate,
    IFNULL(T1.name,'No Info')                   AS ListedBuildingName,
    IFNULL(T1.organisation_entity,'No Info')    AS ListedBuildingOrganisationEntity,
    IFNULL(T1.point,'No Info')                  AS ListedBuildingPrefix,
    IFNULL(T1.prefix,'No Info')                 AS ListedBuildingPoint,
    IFNULL(T1.reference,'No Info')              AS ListedBuildingReference,
    IFNULL(T1.start_date,'No Info')             AS ListedBuildingStartDate,
    IFNULL(T1.typology,'No Info')               AS ListedBuildingTypology,
    IFNULL(T1.documentation_url,'No Info')      AS ListedBuildingDocumentation,
    IFNULL(T1.listed_building,'No Info')        AS ListedBuildingNumber,
    IFNULL(T1.listed_building_grade,'No Info')  AS ListedBuildingGrade,
    T2.SourceSystemID                           AS SourceSystemID,
    to_timestamp(T1.expected_from)              AS IngestionDate,
    NULL                                        AS ValidTo,
    md5(concat( 
        IFNULL(T1.entity,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.entry_date,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.name,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.organisation_entity,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.point,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.prefix,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.reference,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.start_date,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.typology,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.documentation_url,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.listed_building,'.'), 
        IFNULL(T1.listed_building_grade,'.')
    ))                                          AS RowID, 
    'Y'                                         AS IsActive, 
    T3.IsActive                                 AS HistoricIsActive

FROM odw_standardised_db.listed_building T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.main_sourcesystem_fact T2 
    ON  "ListedBuilding" = T2.Description AND 
        T2.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL JOIN odw_harmonised_db.listed_building_dim T3 
    ON  T1.reference = T3.ListedBuildingReference AND 
        T3.IsActive = 'Y'

WHERE
        -- flags new data        
        ( CASE
            WHEN    T1.reference = T3.ListedBuildingReference AND 
                    md5(concat(
                        IFNULL(T1.entity,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.entry_date,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.name,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.organisation_entity,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.point,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.prefix,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.reference,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.start_date,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.typology,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.documentation_url,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.listed_building,'.'), 
                        IFNULL(T1.listed_building_grade,'.')))  <> T3.RowID     
            THEN 'Y'
            WHEN T3.ListedBuildingID IS NULL
            THEN 'Y'
            ELSE 'N'
        END  = 'Y' )
    AND T1.reference IS NOT NULL
    AND T1.expected_from = (SELECT MAX(expected_from) FROM odw_standardised_db.listed_building);

        Source.ListedBuildingName,

        Source.ListedBuildingPrefix,
        Source.ListedBuildingPoint,

## Table odw_harmonised.listed_building_outline_dim is updated

%%sql
-- merge into fact table

MERGE INTO odw_harmonised_db.listed_building_outline_dim AS Target
USING listed_building_outline_dim_changed_rows_final AS Source

ON Source.ListedBuildingOutlineID = Target.ListedBuildingOutlineID

-- For Updates existing rows

WHEN MATCHED
    THEN 
    UPDATE SET
    Target.ValidTo = to_timestamp(ClosingDate),
    Target.IsActive = 'N'

-- Insert completely new rows
WHEN NOT MATCHED 
    THEN INSERT (ListedBuildingOutlineID,
        ListedBuildingOutlineEntity,
        ListedBuildingOutlineEntryDate,
        ListedBuildingOutlineGeometry,
        ListedBuildingOutlineName,

AS

SELECT DISTINCT

    T2.FirstName,

    T1.CompanyCode,
    T4.LocationID as Loc,

    T3.ContractCode as WorkC,
    T3.Description as WorkContract,
    T0.EmploymentStartDate as OrgStartDate,
    T0.EmploymentEndDate as Leaving,
    T0.Act, 
    T0.ActionType,
    T0.ActR,
    T0.ReasonForLeaving,
    T0.S,
    T2.EmploymentStatus,
    T11.EmployeeNumber,
    T9.PositionCode as Position,

    T2.AnnualSalary,

    T0.UserID,

    TM3.EmployeeID as PersNo1,
    CONCAT(TM3.FirstName, ' ', TM3.LastName) AS NameOfManager,

    'Y' as IsActive

LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_record_fact T1 ON T0.EmployeeID = T1.EmployeeID and T1.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_employee_dim T2 ON T0.EmployeeID = T2.EmployeeID and T2.IsActive = 'Y'

LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_employee_hr_hierarchy_dim T5 ON T0.EmployeeID = T5.EmployeeID and T5.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_organisation_unit_dim T6 ON T1.OrganisationalUnitID = T6.OrganisationUnitID and T6.IsActive = 'Y'

LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_position_dim TM2 ON TM1.PositionID = TM2.PositionID and TM2.IsActive = 'Y'

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW odw_curated_db.vw_mipins_hr_fact_sickness_union

AS

SELECT DISTINCT

vw.StaffNumber,
date.financial_year AS MeasureYear,
COUNT(*) as SicknessCount


FROM odw_curated_db.mipins_fact_absence_all vw
FULL JOIN default.calendar_dim_plus date on date.calendarDate = vw.AbsenceDate
WHERE vw.AbsenceType in  ('Sickness') and financial_year in ('CurrentFY','PreviousFY') 
GROUP BY StaffNumber
      ,financial_year


UNION

SELECT DISTINCT

vw.StaffNumber,
date.calendar_year,
COUNT(*) as SicknessCount


FROM odw_curated_db.mipins_fact_absence_all vw
FULL JOIN default.calendar_dim_plus date on date.calendarDate = vw.AbsenceDate
WHERE vw.AbsenceType in  ('Sickness') and calendar_year in ('CurrentCY','PreviousCY') 
GROUP BY StaffNumber
      ,calendar_year
ORDER BY StaffNumber

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW odw_curated_db.vw_mipins_hr_fact_sickness

AS

SELECT * FROM odw_curated_db.vw_mipins_hr_fact_sickness_union
PIVOT
(
      MAX(SicknessCount)
      FOR MeasureYear IN ('PreviousFY','CurrentFY','PreviousCY','CurrentCY')
) order by StaffNumber

expected_from = ''

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW staff_cost AS 
SELECT DISTINCT
    h.pers_no as EmployeeID,
    h.ps_group as Grade, 
	h.annual_salary as Salary, 
    cast(cast(h.annual_salary as float)/(365.0*7.4) as float) as HourlyRate,
    cast(${EXPECTED_FROM_VAR} as date) as ReportMonthEndDate,
    le.LeaveDaysPerYear as LeaveAllowance,
    cast(case sign(datediff(day, cast(le.LeaveYearStart as date), ${EXPECTED_FROM_VAR}))
				when 1 then le.LeaveYearStart
				when 0 then le.LeaveYearStart
				else dateadd(year, -1, le.LeaveYearStart)
			end as date) as LeaveStartDate,
    le.leavedaysperyear*(1 - abs((((datediff(day, cast(
                                                    CASE sign(datediff(day, cast(le.leaveyearstart AS date), ${EXPECTED_FROM_VAR}))
                                                    WHEN 1 THEN
                                                    le.leaveyearstart
                                                    ELSE dateadd(year, -1, le.leaveyearstart)
                                                    END
                                                    AS date), ${EXPECTED_FROM_VAR}))/364.25)%1))) AS ExpectedLeaveHoursRemaining
    
FROM odw_standardised_db.vw_saphr h
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_leave_entitlement_dim le on h.pers_no = le.EmployeeID
WHERE
    le.AbsenceQuotaType = 'Annual Leave / P&P' 
    AND le.IsActive = 'Y'

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW carried_over AS 
SELECT DISTINCT
    h.pers_no AS EmployeeID,
    FORMAT_NUMBER( 
        CASE
            SIGN(le.LeaveDaysPerYear - 148) 
            WHEN
                1 
            THEN
                148 
            WHEN
                0 
            THEN
                148 
            ELSE
                le.LeaveDaysPerYear 
        END
    , 2) AS CarriedOverHours 
FROM
    odw_standardised_db.vw_saphr h 
    LEFT JOIN
        odw_harmonised_db.hr_leave_entitlement_dim le 
        ON h.pers_no = le.EmployeeID 
WHERE
    le.AbsenceQuotaType = 'Brought Forward' 
    AND le.IsActive = 'Y';

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW leave_taken AS 
SELECT DISTINCT
   a.EmployeeID,
   CASE
      WHEN
         sc.ReportMonthEndDate >= a.AbsenceEndDate 
      THEN
         a.Hours 
      ELSE
         a.Hours - (w.WorkDayHours * datediff(a.AbsenceEndDate, sc.ReportMonthEndDate)) 
   END
   AS LeaveHours, 
   a.Days, 
   a.Hours, 
   a.CalendarDays, 
   a.AbsenceStartDate, 
   a.AbsenceEndDate, 
   sc.LeaveStartDate 
FROM
   odw_harmonised_db.hr_absence_dim a 
   LEFT JOIN
      odw_harmonised_db.hr_work_schedule_dim w 
      ON a.WorkScheduleID = w.WorkScheduleID 
   LEFT JOIN
      staff_cost sc 
      ON a.EmployeeID = sc.EmployeeID 
WHERE
   a.AbsenceType IN 
   (
      'PT Annual / P&P Leave', 'FT Annual / Priv Leave'
   )

# Check for new, updated or deleted data
- This script checks for new, updated or deleted data by checking the source data (horizon tables) against the target (odw_harmonised_db.casework tables)
- **New Data:** where an main Reference in the source does not exist in the target, then NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Updated data:** Comparison occurs on Reference Fields in source and in target where the row hash is different i.e. there is a change in one of the columns. NewData flag is set to 'Y'
- **Deleted data:** where an Reference info in the target exists but the same identifyers don't exist in the source. DeletedData flag is set to 'Y'

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW staff_cost

     AS

SELECT DISTINCT
    h.EmployeeID                                                AS EmployeeID,
    p.PSGroupCode                                               AS Grade, 
    h.AnnualSalary                                              AS Salary, 
    cast(cast(h.AnnualSalary as float)/(365.0*7.4) as float)    AS HourlyRate,
    cast(le.ExpectedFrom as date)                               AS ReportMonthEndDate,
    le.LeaveDaysPerYear                                         AS LeaveAllowance,
    cast(case sign(datediff(day, cast(le.LeaveYearStart as date), le.expectedfrom))
                when 1 then le.LeaveYearStart
                when 0 then le.LeaveYearStart
                else dateadd(year, -1, le.LeaveYearStart)
            end as date) as LeaveStartDate,
    le.leavedaysperyear*(1 - abs((((datediff(day, cast(
            CASE sign(datediff(day, cast(le.leaveyearstart AS date), le.expectedfrom))
                WHEN 1 
                THEN le.leaveyearstart
            ELSE dateadd(year, -1, le.leaveyearstart)
            END AS date), le.expectedfrom))/364.25)%1)))        AS ExpectedLeaveHoursRemaining
    
FROM odw_harmonised_db.hr_employee_dim h
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_leave_entitlement_dim le on h.EmployeeID = le.EmployeeID
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_record_fact r ON h.EmployeeID = r.EmployeeID AND r.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_payband_dim p ON r.PayBandID = r.PayBandID
WHERE
    h.IsActive = 'Y' AND
    le.AbsenceQuotaType = 'Annual Leave / P&P';

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW carried_over
    
    AS

SELECT DISTINCT
    h.EmployeeID as EmployeeID,
    case sign(le.LeaveDaysPerYear - 148)
        when 1 then 148
        when 0 then 148
        else le.LeaveDaysPerYear
    end as CarriedOverHours

FROM odw_harmonised_db.hr_employee_dim h
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_leave_entitlement_dim le on h.EmployeeID = le.EmployeeID
WHERE
    le.AbsenceQuotaType = 'Brought Forward';

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW leave_taken

     AS

SELECT DISTINCT
    a.AbsenceID,
    a.EmployeeID,
    CASE
        WHEN sc.ReportMonthEndDate >= a.AbsenceEndDate
        THEN a.Hours
        ELSE a.Hours - (w.WorkDayHours * datediff(a.AbsenceEndDate, sc.ReportMonthEndDate))
    END AS LeaveHours,
    a.Days, 
    a.Hours,
    a.CalendarDays,
    a.AbsenceStartDate,
    a.AbsenceEndDate,
    sc.LeaveStartDate

FROM odw_harmonised_db.hr_absence_dim a
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_work_schedule_dim w on a.WorkScheduleID = w.WorkScheduleID
LEFT JOIN staff_cost sc ON a.EmployeeID = sc.EmployeeID
WHERE
    a.AbsenceType IN ('PT Annual / P&P Leave', 'FT Annual / Priv Leave')
    AND 
    a.AbsenceStartDate  BETWEEN sc.LeaveStartDate AND sc.ReportMonthEndDate
GROUP BY 
    a.EmployeeID,a.AbsenceID,a.Days,a.Hours,a.CalendarDays,a.AbsenceStartDate,a.AbsenceEndDate,sc.LeaveStartDate,w.WorkDayHours,sc.ReportMonthEndDate
Order by AbsenceStartDate

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW leave_taken_fixed

    AS

SELECT
EmployeeID,
SUM(LeaveHours) AS LeaveHoursTaken

FROM leave_taken
Where EmployeeID is not null and LeaveStartDate <= AbsenceStartDate
GROUP BY EmployeeID;

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW odw_curated_db.vw_mipins_hr_protected_data

AS

SELECT DISTINCT
		T10.CalendarDate AS PCDate,
		Left(T10.CalendarMonth,3) AS PCMonth,
		T10.MonthOfYear AS MonthInt,
		concat(Left(T10.CalendarMonth,3),' - ', Right(T10.CalendarYear, 2)) AS PCMonthLatest, 
		concat('-',T10.CalendarYear,Right(100+T10.MonthOfYear,2)) AS MonthYearLatestSortKey,
		T10.CalendarYear AS PCYear,
		T10.FinancialYear AS PCFY,
		concat('FY-',Right(T10.FinancialYear, 2))  AS PCFYLatest,
		T10.FinancialYear AS FYLatestSortKey,
		T1.SourceID AS RefNumber,
		T2.DisabilityCode AS DisabilityText,
		CASE 
			WHEN T2.Description IS NULL THEN 'No Record'
			WHEN T2.Description IN ('DISABLED','Yes') THEN 'Yes'
			WHEN T2.Description IN ('NOT DISABLED', 'No') THEN 'No'
			WHEN T2.Description IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose', '0') THEN 'Unknown'
		END AS Disabled,
		T3.Description AS EthnicOrigin,
		CASE WHEN T3.Description IS NULL THEN 'No Record'
			WHEN T3.Description LIKE 'White%' THEN 'White'
			WHEN T3.Description IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','0','Not known') THEN 'Unknown'
		   ELSE 'BME'
		END AS Ethnicity,
		CASE
			WHEN T1.ReligionID IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
			ELSE T4.ReligionCode 
		END AS ReligiousDenominationKey,
		CASE
			WHEN T4.ReligionCode IS NULL THEN 'No Record'
			WHEN T4.ReligionCode IN ('None','Agnostic / Atheist') OR LEFT(T4.ReligionCode,3) IN ('ath','agn') THEN 'Agnostic / Atheist'
			WHEN T4.ReligionCode = 'Christian' THEN 'Christian'
			WHEN T4.ReligionCode IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','0') THEN 'Unknown'
		   	ELSE 'Other Religion'
		END AS Religion,
		T5.Description AS SxO,
		CASE 
			WHEN T5.Description IS NULL THEN 'No Record'
			WHEN T5.Description ='Heterosexual' THEN 'Heterosexual'
			WHEN LEFT(T5.Description,3) IN ('Gay','Les','Bis') THEN 'LGBT'
			WHEN T5.Description IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','Other','0') THEN 'Unknown'
		    ELSE 'Other'
		END AS SexualOrientation,
		'1' AS PCHeadcount,
		CASE 
			WHEN T2.Description IS NULL OR T2.Description IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','0','Not known') 
				THEN 'No Record or Data not supplied for one or more categories.'
	  	    WHEN T3.Description IS NULL OR T3.Description IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','0','Not known') 
				THEN 'No Record or Data not supplied for one or more categories.'
			WHEN T4.ReligionCode IS NULL OR T4.ReligionCode IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','0','Not known') 
				THEN 'No Record or Data not supplied for one or more categories.'
			WHEN T5 .Description IS NULL OR T5 .Description IN ('PREFER NOT TO SAY','Not disclosed','Do not wish to disclose','Unknown','0','Not known') 
				THEN 'No Record or Data not supplied for one or more categories.'
	   		ELSE 'Records Complete'
	   END AS DataCompleteness

	FROM odw_harmonised_db.hr_secure_info_fact T1
	LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_disability_dim T2 ON T1.DisabilityID = T2.DisabilityID and T2.IsActive = 'Y'
	LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_diversity_dim T3 ON T1.DiversityID = T3.DiversityID and T3.IsActive = 'Y'
	LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_religion_dim T4 ON T1.ReligionID = T4.ReligionID and T4.IsActive = 'Y'
	LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_sxo_dim T5 ON T1.SXOID = T5.SXOID and T5.IsActive = 'Y'
	LEFT OUTER JOIN  default.calendar_dim_plus T10 ON DATEADD(month, -1, T1.IngestionDate) = T10.CalendarDate

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW odw_curated_db.vw_mipins_fact_absence_all
AS

SELECT DISTINCT
    T7.CalendarDate AS AbsenceDate,
    -- T1.AbsenceStartDate,
    -- T1.AbsenceEndDate,
    T1.Hours AS AbsenceHours,
    T1.EmployeeID AS StaffNumber,
    T6.WorkScheduleRule,
    T1.AbsenceType,
    T1.SicknessGroup,
    CASE 
        WHEN AbsenceType = 'Sickness' THEN 'Sickness'
        WHEN AbsenceType LIKE '%Annual%' THEN 'Annual'
        ElSE '0'
    END AS AbsenceGroup,
    CASE    
        WHEN T6.WorkDayHours = 0 THEN T1.HOURS
        WHEN T6.WorkDayHours = '' THEN T1.HOURS
        WHEN T6.WorkDayHours IS NULL THEN T1.HOURS
        ELSE T1.Hours/T6.WorkDayHours
    END AS Leave,
	case date_part("DAYOFWEEK",AbsenceStartDate)
		when 2 then T6.WorkDayHours/7.4
		when 3 then T6.WorkDayHours/7.4
		when 4 then T6.WorkDayHours/7.4
		when 5 then T6.WorkDayHours/7.4
		when 6 then T6.WorkDayHours/7.4
		else null
	end as LeaveONS,
    -- T6.WorkDayHours,
    -- T5.Description PayBand,
    T5.PSGroupCode AS PSGroup,
    T3.Description AS PersonnelArea,
    T4.Description AS PersonnelSubArea,
    T1.AbsenceID AS SicknessID,
	T1.Days as SicknessLength,
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(Days AS FLOAT) > 20.0 then 'long-term'
		ELSE 'short-term'
    END AS SicknessLengthType

FROM odw_harmonised_db.hr_absence_dim T1
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_record_fact T2 ON T1.EmployeeID=T2.EmployeeID AND T2.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_personnel_area_dim T3 ON T3.PersonnelAreaID=T2.PersonnelAreaID AND T3.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_personnel_sub_area_dim T4 ON T4.PersonnelSubAreaID=T2.PersonnelSubAreaID AND T4.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_payband_dim T5 ON T5.PayBandID=T2.PayBandID AND T5.IsActive = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN odw_harmonised_db.hr_work_schedule_dim T6 ON T6.WorkScheduleID = T2.WorkScheduleID AND T6.IsActive = 'Y'
FULL OUTER JOIN default.calendar_dim_plus T7 ON T7.CalendarDate >= T1.AbsenceStartDate AND T7.CalendarDate <= T1.AbsenceEndDate

WHERE T1.IsActive = 'Y'
ORDER BY StaffNumber,AbsenceDate

# NSIP Project Subscribe

Using a predefined subscription to a topic; read the messages and save them to the data lake

See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/samples/azure/azure-sdk-for-python/servicebus-samples/ for servicebus samples
## Sets the notebook variables

from notebookutils import mssparkutils

#destination variables
jobId = mssparkutils.env.getJobId()
storage_account=mssparkutils.notebook.run('/utils/py_utils_get_storage_account')
raw_storage_container = 'abfss://odw-raw@' + storage_account
raw_storage_source_folder = 'odt/'
raw_storage_folder_path = raw_storage_container + raw_storage_source_folder

#service bus variables
secret_name="odt-message-queue-connection-string"
kv_linked_service="ls_kv"
topic_name="nsip-project"
subscription_name="nsip-project-odw"
max_records = 10

import json
from datetime import date
import os


def writeData(logger, filename, data):
    try:
        raw_storage_sub_folder = topic_name +'/' +str(date.today())
        destination_dir = '/synfs/' +jobId +'/temp_raw/' +raw_storage_sub_folder+'/'
        #create the destination_directory, if it doesn't already exist
        os.makedirs(destination_dir, exist_ok=True)

        with open(f"{destination_dir}{filename}", "w") as f:
            json.dump(data, f)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(e)
        return False
    return True
## Get the latest messages from the subscription and write to the data lake

def saveFromSubscription():
    from azure.servicebus import ServiceBusClient, ServiceBusMessage
    import json
    import logging
    logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

    from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
    spark = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()
    akv_name=spark.sparkContext.environment.get('keyVaultName', 'get')
    from notebookutils import mssparkutils
    conn_str = mssparkutils.credentials.getSecret(akv_name, secret_name, kv_linked_service)

    

    ### mount the data lake storage in Synapse to the Synapse File Mount API
    try:
        #connect to the service bus
        logger.info("Connecting to Service Bus")
        servicebus_client = ServiceBusClient.from_connection_string(conn_str=conn_str, logging_enable=True)
        logger.info("Mounting " +raw_storage_folder_path)
        mssparkutils.fs.unmount("/temp_raw")
        mssparkutils.fs.mount(raw_storage_folder_path, "/temp_raw", {"linkedService":"ls_storage"}) 
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(e)
        return False

    try:
        with servicebus_client:
            receiver = servicebus_client.get_subscription_receiver(
                topic_name=topic_name,
                subscription_name=subscription_name
            )

            with receiver:
                
                while True:
                    received_msgs = receiver.receive_messages(max_message_count=max_records, max_wait_time=5)
                    
                    if len(received_msgs) > 0:
                        logger.info("Reading " +str(len(received_msgs)) +" messages")

                        for message in received_msgs:
                            #first json.loads unescapes it, second parses it into a json object
                            data = json.loads(str(message))
                            filename = str(message.message_id) +'.json'

                            #save data to blob
                            if writeData(logger, filename, data):
                                receiver.complete_message(message)
                                logger.info("Wrote message to file" +filename)
                            else:
                                logger.error("Failed to write message " +filename)
                    else:
                        logger.info("No messages to process")
                        break
        return True        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(e)
        return False
    finally:
        #cleanup
        logger.info("Unmounting " +raw_storage_folder_path)
        mssparkutils.fs.unmount("/temp_raw")
        logger.info("Finished")
saveFromSubscription()

%%sql

%%sql

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW odw_curated_db.vw_nsip_representation
AS
SELECT DISTINCT
    RR.representationId
    ,RR.referenceId
    ,RR.examinationLibraryRef
    ,COALESCE(RR.caseRef, '') AS caseRef
    ,RR.caseId
    ,CASE
        WHEN RR.status = 'New' OR RR.status = 'In Progress' THEN
            'awaiting_review'
        WHEN RR.status = 'Complete' THEN
            'valid'
        WHEN RR.status = 'Do Not Publish' THEN
            'invalid'
        ELSE 
            LOWER(RR.status)
    END AS status
    ,COALESCE(RR.originalRepresentation, '') AS originalRepresentation
    ,RR.redacted
    ,RR.redactedRepresentation
    ,RR.redactedBy
    ,RR.redactedNotes
    ,CASE
        WHEN su2.serviceUserType = 'Agent' THEN
            'AGENT'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'An Organisation' THEN 
            'ORGANISATION'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'Members of the Public/Businesses' and SU2.Organisation IS NOT NULL THEN
            'ORGANISATION'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'Members of the Public/Businesses' THEN
            'PERSON'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'Another Individual or Organisation' and SU2.Organisation IS NOT NULL THEN
             'ORGANISATION'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'Another Individual or Organisation' THEN
            'PERSON'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'Myself' THEN
            'PERSON'
        ELSE
            RR.representationFrom
    END AS representationFrom
    ,COALESCE(SU.Id, '')AS representedId
    ,COALESCE(SU2.Id, '') AS representativeId
    ,CASE
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'An Organisation' THEN
            'ORGANISATION'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'Members of the Public/Businesses' and SU.Organisation IS NOT NULL THEN
            'ORGANISATION'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'Members of the Public/Businesses'THEN
            'PERSON'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'Another Individual or Organisation' and SU.Organisation IS NOT NULL THEN 
            'ORGANISATION'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'Another Individual or Organisation' THEN
            'PERSON'
        WHEN RR.representationFrom = 'Myself' THEN
            'PERSON'
        ELSE
            RR.registerFor
    END AS registerFor
    ,CASE
        WHEN RR.representationType = 'Other Statutory Consultees' THEN
            'Statutory Consultees'
        ELSE
            RR.representationType
        END AS representationType
        ,RR.dateReceived
        ,RR.attachmentIds
FROM 
        odw_harmonised_db.curated_service_user AS SU2
        INNER JOIN odw_harmonised_db.nsip_representation AS RR
            ON (SU2.sourceSUID = RR.agentcontactid OR SU2.sourceSUID = RR.representativeId)
            AND SU2.serviceUserType IN ('RepresentationContact', 'Agent')
            AND RR.ISActive = 'Y'
        LEFT OUTER JOIN odw_harmonised_db.curated_service_user AS SU
            ON SU.sourceSUID = RR.representedId
            AND SU.serviceUserType IN ('Applicant')

def add_file_to_table(jsonId, year, month, day, hour, minute, second):
    try:
        from datetime import datetime
        dt = datetime(year=year, month=month, day=day,hour=hour,minute=minute,second=second)
        from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
        spark = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()

        config_target_container = "abfss://odw-config@" + spark.sparkContext.environment.get('dataLakeAccountName', 'get') + ".dfs.core.windows.net/"
        standardised_target_container = "abfss://odw-standardised@" + spark.sparkContext.environment.get('dataLakeAccountName', 'get') + ".dfs.core.windows.net/"
        import json
        from pyspark.sql.types import StringType,BooleanType,DateType,TimestampType,IntegerType, FloatType, StructType
        outstanding_files_table_json = spark.read.text(config_target_container + "orchestration/scheduling_outstanding_files_table.json", wholetext=True).first().value
        outstanding_struct_schema = StructType.fromJson(json.loads(outstanding_files_table_json))
        new_outst_file = spark.createDataFrame([[dt, jsonId]], outstanding_struct_schema)
        new_outst_file.write.format("delta").mode("append").save(standardised_target_container+"config/raw_to_std_outstanding_files")
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"For jsonID:{jsonId} for date {year}-{month}-{day}, record failed to be added to raw_to_std_outstanding_files") from e
