Next, we need to look at the master service user table from Horizon for records that we haven't seen before

We have multiple ways we could match this data into the current service_user pot. We will stop at the first hit, and look at:
1. case reference, service user type, and URI match
2. case reference, service user type, Name (separate and joint components), address
3. case reference, service user type, Name (separate and joint components) and telephoneNumber,otherPhoneNumber, or fax
4. case reference, service user type, Name (separate and joint components) and emailAddress

The simplest is a URI match on the contactID from Horizon

%%sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW vw_Horizon_casework_raw
AS
SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS String) AS Id
    ,salutation
    ,firstName
    ,lastName
    ,addressline1
    ,addressline2
    ,addressTown
    ,addressCounty
    ,postcode
    ,addressCountry
    ,organisation
    ,organisationType
    ,role
    ,telephoneNumber
    ,otherPhoneNumber
    ,faxNumber
    ,emailAddress
    ,CAST(NULL AS String) AS webAddress
    ,CASE serviceUserType
         WHEN 'Applicant' THEN
            'Applicant'
        WHEN 'Agent' THEN
            'Agent'
        WHEN 'Apellant' THEN
            'Appellant'
        WHEN 'Appellant' THEN
            'Appellant'
        WHEN 'tAppellant' THEN
            'Appellant'
    END AS serviceUserType
    ,caseReference 
    ,'Horizon' AS sourceSystem
    ,source.ContactID AS sourceSUID -- prefixes on the ContactID are dropped as these aren't consistent in Horizon and cause matching issues.
    ,caseInvolvementID
    ,2 AS Source_priority
FROM
    odw_harmonised_db.casework_case_involvement_dim AS source
WHERE
    source.IsActive = 'Y'
    AND CASE serviceUserType
         WHEN 'Applicant' THEN
            'Applicant'
        WHEN 'Agent' THEN
            'Agent'
        WHEN 'Apellant' THEN
            'Appellant'
        WHEN 'Appellant' THEN
            'Appellant'
        WHEN 'tAppellant' THEN
            'Appellant'
    END IS NOT NULL

%%sql
-- View for match criteria 1
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW vw_Horizon_URI_Match
AS
SELECT
    target.Id
    ,source.caseInvolvementID
FROM
    vw_Horizon_casework_raw AS source
    INNER JOIN odw_harmonised_db.curated_service_user AS target
        ON source.CaseReference = target.caseReference
        AND source.serviceUserType = target.serviceUserType
        AND source.sourceSystem = target.sourceSystem
        AND source.sourceSUID = target.sourceSUID

%%sql
-- View for match criteria 2
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW vw_Horizon_name_Address_Match
AS
SELECT
    target.Id
    ,source.caseInvolvementID
FROM
    vw_Horizon_casework_raw AS source
    INNER JOIN odw_harmonised_db.curated_service_user AS target
        ON source.CaseReference = target.caseReference
        AND source.serviceUserType = target.serviceUserType
        AND ( -- Name match
                CONCAT(COALESCE(source.firstName, ''), ' ', COALESCE(source.lastName, '')) = target.firstName -- some records have all name components merged into one record
                OR CONCAT(COALESCE(source.firstName, ''), ' ', COALESCE(source.lastName, '')) = target.lastName
                OR (-- separated name elements. Coalesce to cater for org only matches
                        COALESCE(source.firstName, '') = COALESCE(target.firstName, '')
                        AND COALESCE(source.lastName, '') = COALESCE(target.lastName, '')
                    )
                OR (-- some org records have been put in the first name, but also need to make sure this isn't a name
                    source.organisation = target.firstName 
                    AND (source.firstName <> target.firstName  AND source.lastName <> target.lastName)
                    AND CONCAT(COALESCE(source.firstName, ''), ' ', COALESCE(source.lastName, '')) <> target.firstName
                )
            )
        AND ( -- Address elements match
                COALESCE(source.AddressLine1, '') = COALESCE(target.AddressLine1, '')
                AND COALESCE(source.AddressLine2, '') = COALESCE(target.AddressLine2, '')
                AND COALESCE(source.addressTown, '') = COALESCE(target.addressTown, '')
                AND COALESCE(source.addressCounty, '') = COALESCE(target.addressCounty, '')
                AND COALESCE(source.postcode, '') = COALESCE(target.postcode, '')
                AND COALESCE(source.organisation, '') = COALESCE(target.organisation, '')
                AND CONCAT(COALESCE(source.AddressLine1, ''),COALESCE(source.AddressLine2, ''), COALESCE(source.addressTown, '') , COALESCE(source.addressCounty, ''), COALESCE(source.postcode, ''), COALESCE(source.organisation, '')) <> ''
            )

%%sql
-- View for match criteria 3
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW vw_Horizon_name_Tel_Match
AS
SELECT
    target.Id
    ,source.caseInvolvementID
FROM
    vw_Horizon_casework_raw AS source
    INNER JOIN odw_harmonised_db.curated_service_user AS target
        ON source.CaseReference = target.caseReference
        AND source.serviceUserType = target.serviceUserType
        AND ( -- Name match
                CONCAT(COALESCE(source.firstName, ''), ' ', COALESCE(source.lastName, '')) = target.firstName -- some records have all name components merged into one record
                OR CONCAT(COALESCE(source.firstName, ''), ' ', COALESCE(source.lastName, '')) = target.lastName
                OR (-- separated name elements. Coalesce to cater for org only matches
                        COALESCE(source.firstName, '') = COALESCE(target.firstName, '')
                        AND COALESCE(source.lastName, '') = COALESCE(target.lastName, '')
                    )
                OR (-- some org records have been put in the first name, but also need to make sure this isn't a name
                    source.organisation = target.firstName 
                    AND (source.firstName <> target.firstName  AND source.lastName <> target.lastName)
                    AND CONCAT(COALESCE(source.firstName, ''), ' ', COALESCE(source.lastName, '')) <> target.firstName
                )
            )
        AND ( -- At least one telephone element matches
                source.telephoneNumber = target.telephoneNumber
                OR source.otherPhoneNumber = target.otherPhoneNumber
                OR source.faxNumber = target.faxNumber
            )

%%sql
-- View for match criteria 4
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW vw_Horizon_email_match
AS
SELECT
    target.Id
    ,source.caseInvolvementID

%%sql
-- View to dedupe results and make sure we have a one to one mapping on upsert
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW vw_rel_reps_Upsert
AS
WITH match_results 
AS
(
    SELECT
        Id
        ,NSIPRepresentaionID
    FROM
        vw_rel_reps_URI_Match
    UNION
    SELECT
        address.Id
        ,address.NSIPRepresentaionID
    FROM
        vw_rel_reps_name_Address_Match AS address
        LEFT OUTER JOIN vw_rel_reps_URI_Match AS uri
            ON address.NSIPRepresentaionID = uri.NSIPRepresentaionID
    WHERE
        uri.NSIPRepresentaionID IS NULL
    UNION
    SELECT
        tel.Id
        ,tel.NSIPRepresentaionID
    FROM
        vw_rel_reps_name_Tel_Match AS tel
        LEFT OUTER JOIN vw_rel_reps_name_Address_Match AS address
            ON tel.NSIPRepresentaionID = address.NSIPRepresentaionID
        LEFT OUTER JOIN vw_rel_reps_URI_Match AS uri
            ON tel.NSIPRepresentaionID = uri.NSIPRepresentaionID
    WHERE
        uri.NSIPRepresentaionID IS NULL
        AND address.NSIPRepresentaionID IS NULL
    UNION
    SELECT
        email.Id
        ,email.NSIPRepresentaionID
    FROM
        vw_rel_reps_email_match AS email
        LEFT OUTER JOIN vw_rel_reps_name_Tel_Match AS tel
            ON email.NSIPRepresentaionID = tel.NSIPRepresentaionID
        LEFT OUTER JOIN vw_rel_reps_name_Address_Match AS address
            ON email.NSIPRepresentaionID = address.NSIPRepresentaionID
        LEFT OUTER JOIN vw_rel_reps_URI_Match AS uri
            ON email.NSIPRepresentaionID = uri.NSIPRepresentaionID
    WHERE
        uri.NSIPRepresentaionID IS NULL
        AND address.NSIPRepresentaionID IS NULL
        AND tel.NSIPRepresentaionID IS NULL
),
dedupe
AS
(
    SELECT
        Row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY id ORDER BY NSIPRepresentaionID DESC) AS MatchID
        ,Id
        ,NSIPRepresentaionID
    FROM
        match_results
)

    ,raw.salutation

    ,raw.lastName

    ,raw.sourceSystem

    ,raw.Source_priority
FROM
    vw_rel_reps_raw AS raw
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dedupe

    CASE

    T1.IsActive as HistoricIsActive

        END  = 'Y' ) OR
        -- flags deleted data

        END = 'Y' )
    )
;

#### Sample notebook showing how to join a flat table with a spark table with arrays

The example below shows the following:  

You have a table from Service Bus which has an array field for attachmentIds.  
You have a similar table from Horizon with attachmentIds in a flat schema - 1 row per attachmentId.  
You want to merge them together into a final table, e.g. curated layer, joining on the primary key, in this case "caseId".  

1. Create spark dataframes for each table.  
2. Explode the service bus array field "attachmentIds" so you have 1 attachmentId per row.  
3. Union the 2 dataframes as they have the same column names.  
4. Group all the attachmentIds into an array using the collect_list function, grouping by the primary key, "caseId".  
5. Use this final dataframe to load / create the final table.  

**NB: this is just an example of how this can be achieved. Each use case should be examined to see if this approach is appropriate for that particular entity**

from pyspark.sql.types import IntegerType, ArrayType, StructType, StructField
from pyspark.sql import Row
from pyspark.sql.functions import *

service_bus_table = "odw_standardised_db.spark_table_sb"
horizon_table = "odw_standardised_db.spark_table_horizon"
spark_table_final = "odw_standardised_db.spark_table_final"

service_bus_schema = StructType([
    StructField("caseId", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    StructField("attachmentIds", ArrayType(IntegerType()), nullable=True)

service_bus_data = [
    Row(caseId=1, attachmentIds=[101, 102, 103]),
    Row(caseId=2, attachmentIds=[201, 202]),
    Row(caseId=3, attachmentIds=[301])

spark.sql(f"drop table if exists {service_bus_table}")
spark.sql(f"drop table if exists {horizon_table}")
spark.sql(f"drop table if exists {spark_table_final}")
service_bus_df = spark.createDataFrame(service_bus_data, schema=service_bus_schema)
service_bus_df.write.saveAsTable(f"{service_bus_table}")

horizon_schema = StructType([
    StructField("caseId", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    StructField("attachmentId", IntegerType(), nullable=False)

horizon_data = [
    Row(caseId=1, attachmentId=1010),
    Row(caseId=1, attachmentId=1020),
    Row(caseId=1, attachmentId=1030),
    Row(caseId=2, attachmentId=2010),
    Row(caseId=2, attachmentId=2020),
    Row(caseId=3, attachmentId=3010)
horizon_df = spark.createDataFrame(horizon_data, schema=horizon_schema)
horizon_df.write.saveAsTable(f"{horizon_table}")
service_bus_df = spark.sql(f"select * from {service_bus_table}")
display(service_bus_df)
horizon_df = spark.sql(f"select * from {horizon_table}")
display(horizon_df)
service_bus_df_explode = service_bus_df.select("caseId", explode("attachmentIds").alias("attachmentId"))
display(service_bus_df_explode)
final_df = service_bus_df_explode.union(horizon_df).groupBy("caseId").agg(collect_list("attachmentId").alias("attachmentIds"))
display(final_df)
final_df.printSchema()
final_df.write.saveAsTable(f"{spark_table_final}")

import json

import os


def writeData(logger, filename, data):
    try:
        raw_storage_sub_folder = subfolder +'/' +str(date.today())
        destination_dir = '/synfs/' +jobId +'/temp_raw/' +raw_storage_sub_folder+'/'
        #create the destination_directory, if it doesn't already exist
        os.makedirs(destination_dir, exist_ok=True)

        with open(f"{destination_dir}{filename}", "w") as f:
            json.dump(data, f)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(e)
        return False
    return True
## Get the latest messages from the subscription and write to the data lake

def saveFromSubscription():
    from azure.servicebus import ServiceBusClient, ServiceBusMessage
    import json
    import logging
    logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

    from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
    spark = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()
    akv_name=spark.sparkContext.environment.get('keyVaultName', 'get')
    from notebookutils import mssparkutils
    conn_str = mssparkutils.credentials.getSecret(akv_name, secret_name, kv_linked_service)

    

    ### mount the data lake storage in Synapse to the Synapse File Mount API
    try:
        #connect to the service bus
        logger.info("Connecting to Service Bus")
        servicebus_client = ServiceBusClient.from_connection_string(conn_str=conn_str, logging_enable=True)
        logger.info("Mounting " +raw_storage_folder_path)
        mssparkutils.fs.unmount("/temp_raw")
        mssparkutils.fs.mount(raw_storage_folder_path, "/temp_raw", {"linkedService":"ls_storage"}) 
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(e)
        return False

    try:
        with servicebus_client:
            receiver = servicebus_client.get_subscription_receiver(
                topic_name=topic_name,
                subscription_name=subscription_name
            )

            with receiver:
                
                while True:
                    received_msgs = receiver.receive_messages(max_message_count=max_records, max_wait_time=5)
                    
                    if len(received_msgs) > 0:
                        logger.info("Reading " +str(len(received_msgs)) +" messages")

                        for message in received_msgs:
                            data = json.loads(str(message))
                            filename = message.subject +"-" +str(message.message_id) +'.json'

                            #save data to blob
                            if writeData(logger, filename, data):
                                receiver.complete_message(message)
                                logger.info("Wrote message to file " +filename)
                            else:
                                logger.error("Failed to write message " +filename)
                    else:
                        logger.info("No messages to process")
                        break
        return True        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(e)
        return False
    finally:
        #cleanup
        logger.info("Unmounting " +raw_storage_folder_path)
        mssparkutils.fs.unmount("/temp_raw")
        logger.info("Finished")
saveFromSubscription()

def get_zendesk_data(file_path: str) -> DataFrame:
    """
    Reads Zendesk json files into a DataFrame

    Returns:
        Spark DataFrame
    """

    file_rdd = spark.read.text(file_path, wholetext=True).rdd
    data = file_rdd.take(1)[0]['value']
    if data.startswith('\ufeff'):
        data = data[1:]
    json_data = json.loads(data)
    results = json_data[0]["results"]

    pddf=pd.DataFrame(results)

    pddf=pddf.applymap(str)
    pddf = pddf.dropna(axis='columns', how='all') # Drops columns with all NA values

    df = spark.createDataFrame(pddf)

    partition = Window.partitionBy("SourceSystemID").orderBy('id')
    df = df.withColumn("SourceSystemID",lit(6)).withColumn('IngestionDate', F.current_timestamp()).withColumn('ValidTo', lit("NULL")).withColumn('IsActive', lit("Y")).withColumn('RowID', row_number().over(partition))

    return df

Zendesk steps:
1. Take a system extract from the SAP storgae and save it in the the blob storage (abfss://odw-raw@pinsstodwdevuks9h80mb.dfs.core.windows.net/ZenDesk/Export/export-2023-03-15-1051-10932060-13758561992081e5c3.json)
2. Since the export file holds multiple zendesk tickets, run the odw-raw/zendesk_standardised_and_harmonised notebook to load the file and separate it in one json per ticket. 
3. Then run zendesk_raw_to standardised to load the export into the standardised table and also create the custom_fileds and fileds notebooks which hold the ref number in harmonised layer. Then run the harmonised notebook called zendesk harmonised export to add the remaining nested data fields into tables.
4. the reason behind creating all diffrent tables from harmonised this way rather than the way other tables were created is becasue all the data in the zendesk tickets is nested. Also, in adition all tickets are diffrent from each other containg diffrent column names and information. The information in columns is also writen by users so it can't always be trusted (eg  the custom_fields/fields column has id and value which holds the ticket reference to other table. That info was added by a user manually and the UI does not require the user to put a valid Ref Number)
5. After the zendesk standardised and harmonised has been build we have created a pipeline called 0_Zendesk_API_to_RAW which pulls every 24 hours the data from the storage using an api and loads it into the standardised table called zendesk_system_extract
6. In case of any missing data we use the 0_Zendesk_API_to_RAW historical pipeline whcih downloads all tickets existing in zendesk.
7. In order to update the standardised table with all the data, go to the zendesk_historical notebook in odw-raw. BEFORE RUNNING THE NOTEBOOK YOU MUST CHNAGE THE NAME OF THE FILE WITH THE NEW ONE. eg go to the zendesk_hist function and change :"with open(f"/synfs/{jobId}/zendesk_items/historical_2023-09-04.json", 'r',encoding="utf-8-sig") as json_file: " to "with open(f"/synfs/{jobId}/zendesk_items/NAME OF THE FILE", 'r',encoding="utf-8-sig") as json_file: ". NAME OF THE FILE can be found abfss://odw-raw@pinsstodwdevuks9h80mb.dfs.core.windows.net/ZenDesk/historical/historical_2023-09-04.json and should have the date on which the pipeline 0_Zendesk_API_to_RAW historical was run on.

def write_to_single_file():
    

    with open(f"/synfs/{jobId}/zendesk_items/export-2023-03-15-1051-10932060-13758561992081e5c3.json", 'r',encoding="utf-8") as zendesk_json_raw:

        zendesk_json_decoded = zendesk_json_raw.read()

        zendesk_json_array = zendesk_json_decoded.split("\n")

        item_number = 0

        for zendesk_json_item in zendesk_json_array:

            if zendesk_json_item != "":

                zendesk_json_dict = json.loads(zendesk_json_item)

                with open(f"/synfs/{jobId}/zendesk_items/output_{item_number}.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as write_single_zendesk_json:

                    json.dump(zendesk_json_dict, write_single_zendesk_json)

                item_number += 1

write_to_single_file()
